Peter, Today marks the beginning of Hispanic Heritage Month — a time to honor the culture, history, and contributions that have shaped this state into something worth fighting for.
I’ve lived in Texas my whole life: I was raised in Dallas, studied at UT, built my career in Austin, raised my family here in Central Texas.
**One of the things I love most about this place is that there has never been just “one kind” of Texan.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139353962/647068887/450663877?refcode=du_em_091626_i1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3NDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjAzZDRjYmUtMmFiMi1mMTExLWE2YTctMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=b70GeCyyNSabO7rk6oINZmSpo7Sof0fdsVkdrOA_kwA=)
---
Texas is as vibrant as it is — the food, the music, the art, the agriculture, the communities that hold us together — because of the Mexican families who were here long before statehood. Because of the generations of Hispanic Texans who built this economy with their hands and ideas, who served in every branch of our military, who have run for office and sat on school boards and coached Little League and opened small businesses in every corner of our great state.
**Hispanic heritage is a part of Texas heritage. **
A part that is worth celebrating loudly, and without apology.
The same issues matter to all of us — clean drinking water, affordable housing, public school funding, healthcare that won’t bankrupt our family. These are exactly the issues that Dan Patrick has either ignored or made worse while sitting in the most powerful seat in the legislature.
**His record isn’t good:**
He cut funding to public schools – when half of our public school students are Hispanic. He sided with big-tech data centers – when utility rates keep rising. He’s running on “lowering property taxes” – but they’ve been skyrocketing these last 12 years _on his watch_.
I’m running for Lieutenant Governor because I believe **Texas works best when it works for everyone.** A kid in South San Antonio should have the same shot at a great public education as a kid in a wealthy suburb. A family in El Paso should be able to turn on the tap and trust what comes out. A worker in the Rio Grande Valley should be able to save enough to own a home.
**That is the Texas I believe in. That is the Texas we are going to build ****_together._**
Juntos,
Rep. Vikki Goodwin

Let's be clear about what is happening to reproductive rights, and who is responsible, Peter.
Donald Trump appointed the Supreme Court justices who overturned _Roe v. Wade_. Since then, his administration and Republican allies haven't let up on their attacks. They keep coming after our reproductive freedom — year after year, state by state.
Just last week, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency announced it will be testing wastewater samples in cities across the country for traces of mifepristone and misoprostol — the safe, well-studied, and effective drugs used in miscarriage and abortion care.
Anti-choice groups are taking this as a big win, and so are Republican lawmakers who are hell-bent on controlling our bodies. They'll undoubtedly use this study, which they've dressed up as "environmental concern," as an excuse to further restrict these medications that millions of people rely on.
Women won't be free for as long as anti-choice extremists keep rubber-stamping the Trump administration's attacks on our bodies.
That's why EMILYs List has endorsed Democratic pro-choice women who will refuse to rubber-stamp anything that takes away our rights.

Asking if you hate getting so many political emails is about as useful as asking if you are sick of the high costs and corruption coming from Washington. I get it. Every couple of weeks, I try to offer you a more personal update, without an urgent deadline hanging over our heads (though, honestly, there’s almost always a deadline!). You have made incredible contributions to put us in a position to win, and I wish you could be on the trail with me to feel the momentum and appreciation from every corner of the district. This morning, a local parent of two teenagers told me that our campaign was the first thing that had made their kids feel genuine hope and excitement about politics. Yesterday, I met with a group of veterans who thanked me and the team for “the courage to step into the arena to fight for the Constitution and freedoms they enlisted to protect.” We are giving people a real reason to believe that we will flip this seat back into the hands of the people, and flip the House back into the hands of those who believe in the rule of law. We are also working closely with an amazing slate in Lynchburg who are ready to flip their city council and school board back. Sanity and humanity are making a comeback, and every voter we touch creates ripples of hope building into a wave of momentum. We are less than 48 hours away from the start of voting and 48 days away from Election Day, and we can almost hear the sound of the clock ticking. Every voter that reminds me how much this win would mean to them also plants a seed of constructive anxiety about what it would mean to fall short. Every moment is a chance to reach more voters, recruit more volunteers, and raise more resources that allow us to... well, reach more voters and recruit more volunteers. With your help, we have been running that Sledgehammer ad, and other organizations have been hitting McGuire for his corruption. We are knocking doors every weekend, but always need to hit more. Yes, we are still pushing hard, as mentioned in the last email, to hit our mid-month benchmark of $30,000 raised online by midnight. And are still burning up the roads of Central Virginia and Southside, and hearing how angry voters are that McGuire refuses to show up for public debates or town halls. In Nelson County this week, we had a roundtable with healthcare providers, particularly those connected to mental and behavioral health needs. They were joined by local law enforcement and education leaders from across Central Virginia. We met in a rural health clinic that I landed the federal funding to expand a few years ago, and they had initially expanded the range of services they could provide to rural families under the Affordable Care Act. Now, all of that is at risk because of the big, ugly bill and the healthcare cliff coming in January. When leaders in Congress care, we really can make a difference. And when that power falls into the wrong hands, it can cause so much pain – to the middle class and those on the margins. Campaigns are exhausting, but one gift it gives is clarity of purpose. There’s not been a single day on the trail that I have wondered whether this campaign matters. Whether this is how I can make the most difference right now. The exhaustion is temporary – well, some of it may leave a mark – but the good we can do with a win will echo for years. I know that because I hear the echo every day of the good we did together during my brief time in DC. That is what keeps me going and makes me want to go back. Thank you so much for all of your support of this campaign and for reading these emails. With the countdown to the first – and last – day of voting already on, please know that you have helped us to pave a path to victory. Now let’s do everything we possibly can to run through the tape. Forever grateful,Tom P.S. | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi Peter,
Happy Hispanic Heritage Month and _¡Feliz Día de la Independencia de México!_ 🇲🇽September is a month of power, pride, and celebration, from honoring our roots during Hispanic Heritage Month and Mexican Independence Day to making our voices heard on National Voter Registration Day! 🗳️
There is no better way to celebrate our history than by shaping our future. With only **48 days until Election Day** , we need to hit those doors, talk to voters, and be _La Máquina_ we know how to be! 😤
Join us for our [**Latinos Unidos para Adelita Canvass**](https://us.list-manage.com/14ShRvAY4nb?e=f7c3700ccb&c2id=444a9f520cb2092400304c5b9d69cefc)**** this Saturday, September 19th at 8:30AM from our HQ: 2720 East Broadway BLVD.
Let’s fight for our people, our pueblo, our future!

name: Maggie Hassan
subject: We need Chris in the Senate

body:
Chris and I will make a strong team in the Senate.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260916_4.NQf2Xa&refcode=em20260916-4&t=1&akid=8952%2E582294%2EL3kc-J)
It’s Maggie Hassan.
Chris Pappas and I have worked side by side for years to deliver for New Hampshire. I’ve seen firsthand the kind of leader he is: hard-working, deeply dedicated, and committed to getting things done.
**That’s why I know Chris will be an outstanding Senator, but make no mistake – we have a tough general election battle ahead against John Sununu.**
**[If you’re ready to stand with Chris, take on Sununu, and keep New Hampshire blue, pitch in $5 right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260916_4.NQf2Xa&refcode=em20260916-4&t=2&akid=8952%2E582294%2EL3kc-J)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260916_4.NQf2Xa&amount=5&refcode=em20260916-4&t=21&akid=8952%2E582294%2EL3kc-J)**
Taking on a Sununu in New Hampshire is a massive undertaking. The Sununu family name carries huge weight across our state, and national Republicans are already preparing to pour millions of dollars into this race to flip this seat red.
I know better than anyone just how razor-thin a New Hampshire Senate race can be.
When I first won my seat, I won by just 1,017 votes – that experience taught me that every single vote, every conversation, and every grassroots contribution makes the difference between winning and losing.
Chris isn't part of a political dynasty – he's a small business owner who grew up working at his family's restaurant right here in Manchester. He knows the struggles everyday Granite State families face, and he’s ready to go to Washington to fight special interests, protect reproductive freedom, and lower costs.
When Chris wins this November, we’ll keep working together to defend Social Security and Medicare and deliver for New Hampshire.
**But to withstand the incoming attacks from Sununu and his super PAC allies, Chris needs our full support starting today.**
I’m proud to stand with Chris in this fight. **[Please chip in $5 – or whatever you can afford today – to protect this open Senate seat and keep New Hampshire moving forward.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260916_4.NQf2Xa&refcode=em20260916-4&t=22&akid=8952%2E582294%2EL3kc-J)**

Thank you,

On the night of March 21, 2026, Elon Musk took to X to formally announce "the TERAFAB project" -- a joint venture of Tesla and SpaceX, with xAI (which SpaceX absorbed earlier this year) in the mix and Intel signing on as a manufacturing partner that April. Terafab is a semiconductor fabrication plant built around one staggeringly large number: one terawatt -- 1,000 gigawatts -- of new AI compute capacity produced per year. No fab in history has ever been asked to deliver that, and that's precisely the point. Musk has called it "the most valuable building on Earth by far."
**How big is it?**
The plan calls for more than 100 million square feet of factory floor. Tesla's Gigafactory Texas -- already one of the largest buildings on Earth -- holds roughly 10 million square feet, so Terafab is designed to be about ten times bigger. Fortune, which reviewed the project filings, notes the footprint would be roughly five times larger than the biggest building standing anywhere today. The project's own comparisons: larger than the Pentagon, Apple Park, and the Mall of America combined -- or, if you prefer geography to architecture, roughly the size of Vatican City, Monaco, and Gibraltar rolled into one, all under a single roof.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d094f6ef-3959-47db-bf78-88fbc172249f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Phase one is reported at about $16.8 billion, on a site in Grimes County, Texas, between Austin and Houston. County tax-incentive filings put construction starting December 1, 2026, with completion targeted for the end of 2028 and incentives running through 2038 -- with performance bonds posted to the local Anderson-Shiro and Iola school districts as a guarantee the company actually delivers. Early reports peg initial staffing around 3,000 jobs, and Governor Greg Abbott has touted it as a first-of-its-kind facility for American chipmaking...

clean_body: Every single donation, big or small, added up to something real, and today I just want to say thank you. | | | | Derek, we did it — thank you. We just hit our mid-month fundraising goal, and I mean it when I say we couldn't have done this without you. Every single donation, big or small, added up to something real, and today I just want to say thank you. I know I don't always get to stop and celebrate these moments with you before jumping into the next ask. So take a second with me — this is a genuine win, and you made it happen. But I'd be lying if I said the work stops here. If we want to defeat Tom Tiffany, an election-denying extremist in the pocket of billionaires and Donald Trump, it starts with hitting every single deadline between now and November. Losing is not an option. Here's what it's going to take to win: 🔵 Unity , because we are all in this to win. 🟢 Teamwork,and lots of it. From knocking doors to making phone calls, we must work together to get this done. 🟡 You, Derek. Yes, you! | | Friend,**It passed.** This afternoon, the U.S. House passed the National Fraud Enforcement Division Act, a bill I was proud to author. Through this legislation, the Department of Justice will have a permanent division whose entire job is finding, investigating, and prosecuting the people stealing your tax dollars, not a temporary task force that gets quietly disbanded or another report that sits on a shelf.A standing division, led by a Senate-confirmed Assistant Attorney General, with authority to run investigations across state lines and across agencies, and a mandate to dismantle the organized fraud rings that have been draining federal programs for years. Its prosecutors are barred from political activity, so no administration of either party can turn it into a weapon. **Minnesotans don't need this explained to them.** We watched roughly a quarter of a billion dollars walk out the door in the Feeding Our Future scheme — the largest pandemic fraud case in the country, run right here in our state, with money that was supposed to feed hungry kids. The fraudsters then developed scheme after scheme to defraud program after program, everything from autism services to housing assistance. The people elected and appointed to provide oversight looked the other way as another quarter of a billion dollars vanished.I didn't go to Washington to shrug at that. Every dollar stolen is a dollar a farmer near Fairmont or a small business owner in Winona earned and sent in. And this is exactly why Democrats put Minnesota's First District on the DCCC's “Red to Blue” list: not because we're failing southern Minnesota, but because we're delivering. Effective Republicans are the ones they most want gone, and they have millions in national money lined up to do it.I can't outspend them. But we can close the gap and get the truth out! **If today's fraud bill passage is the kind of work you want representing southern Minnesota, chip in now:**

We know it’s been a lot, Peter, but please hear us out.
[**_We’re about to ask you to rush $5 to help Roy Cooper flip North Carolina’s Senate seat blue for the first time since 2008_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1379&amount=5&t=8&akid=3526%2E124072%2EJdS8t5) – because right now, things aren’t looking great:
Even as national Republicans outspent our grassroots campaign, polling still showed Roy with the slightest edge on his opponent, Michael Whatley.
But after the President came to North Carolina last night to help prop up Whatley’s flailing campaign with a massive MAGA rally, that could soon change.
**We’re now just 47 days out from the election, and GOP super PAC investments to defeat our grassroots movement have officially surpassed $100 million.** The uptick in dark money attacks could easily tip the scales against us if we don’t fight back immediately.
So we’re launching more TV ads, scaling up our on-the-ground voter outreach and everything in between – **but unless we raise an additional $38,000 before 11:59 p.m. tonight to sustain our defensive efforts, they won’t be enough for us to surge back into the lead.**
The future of our country depends on us taking back the Senate majority, and the only way that happens is if we win in NC. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3121%2E259176%2EsqDcFp) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3121%2E259176%2EsqDcFp)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/15505?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.17_Peltola-Mukluk_B1_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON_RS2&t=4&akid=3121%2E259176%2EsqDcFp) Peter - Here’s my plan for how we win this election: This is a ground game. This is person-to-person, human-to-human, mukluk telegraph. For those in the Lower 48, mukluk telegraph is a saying we have in the Bush that basically amounts to gossip. It’s passing along a message through our conversations with one another, _which is the only way information can really spread in some parts of the Last Frontier!_ In a state as vast and rural as ours, there really is no other way to reach every Alaskan. Fellow Concerned American,

Parents send their kids to school to learn reading, writing, math... not sexual orientations and gender identities.

But that’s exactly what’s happening in classrooms across the country.

In New Hampshire, Contoocook Valley School District (ConVal) allows transgender-identified males to use restrooms and locker rooms that correspond to their gender identity rather than their biological sex.

And it gets worse...

**_The Superintendent of the ConVal School District has indicated that the district will NOT comply with federal law_.**

That’s why Defending Education has filed a civil rights complaint against the school district.

Now, the U.S. Department of Education has opened an investigation.

_This is the result of far-left ideology and radical activism_ infiltrating American schools and leading to the creation of terrible policies that disrespect parents and endanger children.

**I’m Nicole Neily, President of Defending Education – a national grassroots organization fighting to restore academic excellence and parental rights in America’s schools.**

We believe every parent has the right to know what is being taught to their child. We believe schools should focus on reading, writing, math, science, and history – not political activism.

And we believe it’s time to ask Americans plainly where they stand.

Please take our one-question poll right now:

name: R. Cooper
subject: This will only take 30 seconds
body:
Will you add your name to endorse my campaign today?
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1378&source=&t=1&akid=3527%2E124072%2ERKkvBD) | | | |
---
Peter, I’m not asking for your money. Let me explain.
President Trump has endorsed my MAGA opponent and attacked me online. Stephen Miller has gone on Fox News to rant and rave about me. GOP dark-money groups are spending millions to run ads statewide with baseless lies about my record.
**Simply put, I can’t win this race without people like you on my side.**
So all I’m asking is that you be one of the 30,000 folks l need to endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina today. [**_Will you take 30 seconds now to add your name?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1378&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=3527%2E124072%2ERKkvBD)

---
I have spent my life trying to do right by the people of North Carolina.
Whether as a state legislator or Attorney General or Governor, I’ve fought hard to protect our fundamental rights, expand health care and put working families first.
**I’m running to take this critical work to Washington DC – but right now, the GOP is spending more in North Carolina than almost any other battleground this cycle to defeat me.**
I know we have what it takes to flip this seat for the first time since 2008, but the only way it happens is if thousands of people like you stand with me in this fight.
[**_So if you’re ready to win in North Carolina, take back the Senate and prevent two more years of unchecked Republican rule, will you endorse my grassroots campaign today?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1378&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=10&akid=3527%2E124072%2ERKkvBD)

---
I really appreciate it.

Roy Cooper
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1378&t=2&akid=3527%2E124072%2ERKkvBD)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Rather than rethink the toxic politics voters rejected, he marched to Capitol Hill to beg Congress to rig elections for MAGA.

| Friend, If you’ve been with us at Defend Our Courts this past year, you remember the name Scott Pressler. We exposed how the MAGA operative and his group, Early Vote Action, were leading the charge to capture Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court.
Pressler is a darling of right-wing organizers, widely considered one of their most effective operatives. Elon Musk has bankrolled his rise, hiring him to lead ’s failed bid to flip the Wisconsin Supreme Court. After that loss, Pressler turned his operation toward Pennsylvania, attempting to topple the PA Supreme Court next.
Because of you, Friend, we didn’t just defeat Pressler. We buried him by 30+ points across Pennsylvania in November. A landslide loss and a brutal blow to his oversized ego.
Now Pressler is back. Rather than rethink the toxic politics voters rejected, he marched to Capitol Hill to beg Congress to rig elections for MAGA:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SHWTzH6KO7u6k1NueS0sEWbUghenx0EnJGiXtGNohkft-3C9SdPS-BufUPn-1Myx30Tlfmtm3QDpLEnLJKjV-no5h1XsuhHPH2PZ73P7OPmKxMYpRRcHstBHbebDKS--l7BrC51zHJJlm0H2ss4ygeDYJP1sZY5f3YGfu6HvBt7YIVRzhJ1MGy-1zWQDWO-c0tF66HCxqNubFOZibPMraWpqCIpPTP91vcjlakF59cotm23BPw4nTlA6RlLfdQyuwt8RzDiehkYwY8_BNnR6xA==&c=FGTj8I_2Iaeha3qIAGMylRsWcT8Ef0ErDfsBIPw6o3-r1u5GaXjUtQ==&ch=B1oNVZClopP-FAdS7-JKa6e8_VYTZqLlI9edsu3rViGJZp5bQOHvCw==)
---
| As they famously say: “If you can’t beat ‘em, rig it.”
This is so pathetic.
After getting blown out repeatedly, Pressler marched into Congress and said the quiet part out loud: MAGA has to rig elections to stop another 2018-style midterm wipeout.

By Pressler’s own admission, the SAVE Act has nothing to do with election integrity. It’s about voter disenfranchisement. The bill MAGA is trying to ram through Congress would strip millions of Americans of their right to vote. In some states, it could effectively ban mail-in voting and open the door to prosecuting election workers.
But thankfully, we have a chance to outmaneuver Pressler again. MAGA has one major flaw in the SAVE Act: elections are controlled by states, not the federal government.
That means state Supreme Courts will play a decisive role in how any federal voting law is interpreted and enforced.
And it means Defend Our Courts’ mission is more important than ever. We’re taking the model that embarrassed Pressler in PA nationwide, scaling up to battle MAGA in key states like Georgia, Michigan, and Wisconsin this year.
Our win in PA wasn’t just built by our team here at DoC HQ. It was powered by more than 100,000 Democrats across the country who chipped in their hard-earned dollars to fuel a winning program. We would love to have you on this team in 2026, Friend.
[Can we count on you rush $50, $25, or whatever you can to help us crush extremist MAGA operatives like Scott Pressler nationwide and stop MAGA’s election-rigging plot dead in its tracks?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SHWTzH6KO7u6k1NueS0sEWbUghenx0EnJGiXtGNohkft-3C9SdPS-BufUPn-1Myx30Tlfmtm3QDpLEnLJKjV-no5h1XsuhHPH2PZ73P7OPmKxMYpRRcHstBHbebDKS--l7BrC51zHJJlm0H2ss4ygeDYJP1sZY5f3YGfu6HvBt7YIVRzhJ1MGy-1zWQDWO-c0tF66HCxqNubFOZibPMraWpqCIpPTP91vcjlakF59cotm23BPw4nTlA6RlLfdQyuu45aO7DCrp6ZdWt_EHktlA==&c=FGTj8I_2Iaeha3qIAGMylRsWcT8Ef0ErDfsBIPw6o3-r1u5GaXjUtQ==&ch=B1oNVZClopP-FAdS7-JKa6e8_VYTZqLlI9edsu3rViGJZp5bQOHvCw==)

## Fed Hikes Rates for First Time Since 2023
The Federal Reserve [raised interest rates](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1urDAUhJ_GdCD_AMaFi9vQ7W1TImMflpMYe2UfLcrbR84rpBtpRt9o5uOxPRxGTM__7gJLR94S3DUCEZTtgHDiF1RMBAUqFUdQn-jSJrmce256oTfnCd-wja4L9gCQoDqwQi9mVmaSvDvtMvl93z14wZVf9LzsGoxSo15EMG5SHdrG40ZowfkkzLBMozoMyDArEwKf2MghIOUyfGZMdMIRv_MbyuDz1UV7Er0qU_-YXJlc7_sefNp9M5lcG5rJlRsmV9HUAaFvS_oAHivm1Fd4EVw7lL6Fh5Ou2BUbXjfGiHXWbOTPy2H8raM_vvS28icAAP__-956fA) a quarter point on Wednesday, its first increase since 2023, bringing the benchmark rate to a range of 3.75% to 4%. Policymakers voted 12-0 and said inflation "[remains elevated](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGSrCAYhE-j2ViAChIQvMRsXrqhxUij7CJMwV9ac_ut2dobbNhJd3_fx3252xBD2v7bA4Z8XhKuGkGEsni4PXyhhkQoqFQsoW7BpkUwIW9M37ha7ErhxDLY1hkPCPQtDFeTlr0eBWt3wx-KCzUxJuTDT6NXI7QVq-olVvbgvA3m3cc0V5yxketuGofeawgne-0cG5uBwQXKpfvMIdEOH1_5ROnWfLTR7ETP2vT_GjE3Yr6uq_NwKDYWVJQT3ZbPRsxvMpxIVBsxPwtqLYiwFe985ASy5fX7RNpup6Mtxj2vEGOoUjUD2w4b4s8o_dHVacR3AAAA__9gkn99)," pushed higher by oil prices from the Iran war and by tariffs. The committee pledged to "deliver price stability." Fed officials signaled another increase was likely this year, saying they don't see inflation back to 2% until 2029. The move [runs against President Trump's](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ_GdCD_gIkLF9vQZdst0cQeh9k1doRHRHn7FVe6T3C7Uxwdne_7c1_vQJnK8zfs6DnVteC7ZWTGY00YN_qHjQrjgY0PYGxPgrJqqW0vXa_mFQLTiesIXfQJUaPp0Kv55qxxk5bd5m00-hEcwIxoo4ZHmOLDqHlMCW8W5o78tSedmpWUk3LDbRpNcqijNS5GOYlRYiSux_C3UuENU_7UE48h1L3LfmN-NWF-Cb0IvSQqUAIOH9hqvRpCLxhqqftH6OVVM4UrwMEUMjahl2--_gLsIwZqVEuf6cQ-YeyVGs1krByHjffcHT6-3pQzNTuLUT53oPz1hH8o8PT6fwAAAP__A_aHKA) stated wishes to see interest rate reductions instead. The increase will eventually fall on borrowers. The average home mortgage rate is currently nearing 7%, new car loans average 7%, used ones 10.6%, and Americans are carrying $1.26 trillion in [credit card debt](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQhZ8GdxMB_gsFxTbu7rZbWtgM9uwlEMEkVt5-xb7C7UYa6ZzvO3--1i9HkdLx2z3QcshrwqtGZMayBvQnfWOlxFiwcnGM9SCXVi31BNKAmle3M71xHVznbUDU2Hdo1Xw3U29GLbvTmjEMRvtxm82EqsdZDkHfdRjvIQQ_7B3ZlieNmpWUozK3-zj0waD2U2-8l6MYJHriXG5_MyU-McRPfmO57fnRRXsyP6vofwm9CL1c13WLeXdRyfYXetlelRLWKvTSioRepBF6Ue0K6KF5QTOFi2KESN8YP_B81RO2XEq-KB2w58oVcoK9NBbYXfEVHrnw4Q6ssL0YNkwYiKG6N5ZW1xXrny2U6jSLQR4PR_E_Nf9w7LfV_wIAAP__ieyVnQ).
## News Helicopter Crash Kills 3 in LA
A news helicopter [crashed in Chatsworth](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1u7CAQRp8Gd7bwgH8oKG7jbm-b0mJhbCZhYQWjtfL20eYV0n_6js75uO03R4ny-d890PJR9oxXS8iMdT8wRPrCRpmxYuPqGNtJLu8gYe6l6cdld57phbt2XbAHIqDq0I7LamZlJpBdtDDhNOHhNd5XWO6j1gbk7FF51EGOa0f2_SfNuIxSTqMZ1kmrwyCEWZkQ5CS0xEBc6vBZKHPEI32XF9bBl0eXbGR-NqH-CdgEbNd1DfnuU2kun5iwvVcCtreYgC0V75KALWIiX56MtffVtYitp9z76LhdpXIUsCmjYVGrgK2rNjwvSonavAgtz4ej9EvnP0Z7WfgJAAD__80BgeU), a Los Angeles neighborhood, just before 7 p.m. Tuesday, killing both crew members aboard and a man on the ground. Aerial photojournalist Eliana Moreno, 38, and pilot George Marciniw were flying NewsChopper4 for NBC4 and Telemundo 52. They were covering an [SUV and Metro bus collision](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM-K5CAYxJ_G3Az-ibE9eFhYcuu97jEY_WydMbHRbzr02w-ZV5hLUVBQVP3-39e7yyUfj39uB4uxrgecvQAitDVCSPkTej4QGnRsDqE_sjtWwcRMmaFcr85jfsE6uSHYCCBADmC5vplZGiXYkKyRWqhNbCpyL6OMUnnn5y1qMxuptRmyvfqY4ZozprgZb2qS0YAIszQhMEUmBiFjbeNHzQcmiOVdX9BGX_eh2IT47ET-IWIhYjnPc3y7VOuVErFch4hYvi5xDbMvcFlOA7hAE5Ts6xOhUd9cT9BpcZQJqbg2kxwT7oXIZfM7EvmXD82G55lLyX3WZGKP3eXyMwN_Se9lxXcAAAD__1Qdgz0) that killed two people about a block and a half away. A livestream of the flight caught whirring engine noise and a woman, believed to be Moreno, telling the pilot to [pull up](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZD0yDZhxQHAJ2V56IWrsZuxbY4_s3lnN35-4X9ispJKeqt6fj-2DYor58ZtOXuQoW-bvlliE63awD_GTW8zClZtUEm6PSHlDjQa0hX7eyEl88TZS55eDGXnoeOnnuzWDnVB3YZmtNqb3ztNokL2fdjwGmo1Hs7u7vndxuXja9nOv9dTb230ah8MyejNY7_WkRs0-Sqm3vyVmCXykd3lxvblydmkJIs-mhl8KV4Vrfj9Lk6tSuF5ghau2Ctf-Sl8NrocK18BUZa9MnzE_4CwnZ4HG1EpmD3l3QNmFUmH_qk0axCwFhKk2KBma48xQDjhIKEEiCJyiK0_hCq5SCwrXri7--R1Tis3MatSPk2L6P1p-6Pq14L8AAAD__0WUlZA) seconds before the crash. Anchors learned of the crash while on the air. _"We knew we'd lost contact with our people out there, and we've just received confirmation,"_ anchor Colleen Williams told viewers. [Watch the emotional moment here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9utDAQBPCnMd2h9Zp_Llx8Dd19bUrks9ewOR8-wQqUPH1EXiHdSCP9pJmP-3T3nHmd__sXOUllWuncM4nQNiWKCz9p51Voo102L7TP7NcJAbsb2JvuJx-ED5oaX0WXiJBMRU73g-2MbRGqxQ3dIwL2QwehsUnHlsAGqyk0Q0iBfMXu8sDqXgO02tZD25hkCWNnbIzQqgYospSt_iy8ykIpf5WDtjqUV5XdIvLelfmncFQ4nudZPx7h6hSO1xyF48GRyhXCEyHP8_dsDJRqc_F9cs68d71qYH55zr-o_PGLw-FPAAAA__8itHN8). The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner identified the third victim as [Edy Gutierrez Mejia, 29](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO3CAQRk-DO1YYbGwKijTu_rQpLQyDmQSDBSOvcvtokyOk_j49Pb0fX_uXw4zl_O4usBTrXuDdMxBB2yOEhL-gYyFo0Kk5gn6iK7sUUnNh-LjszhM-sE9uCDYCSFAD2HFZjVZmlmJI9ljF4ZQ0MIHWKh46miB0iOtonJbCDGg_PGHGZRRiHs1rnScVDciglQlBzGwSEJBqe_2sWChBzL_rA-3l6zVkm4juztQ3JjcmN3f45TMwud21E5Nbrp27ckKGzhNk9PUmaNw31xNXLfAHPeHFMUAhjAiBl8NP_w7QuU-O-rs2Skxuo1mV0UowuQ3NhvuNOWPXC5vEeTnMf53oP1M-Vv4JAAD__ykyiXY), a pedestrian. The NTSB and FAA are investigating.
## US Household Income Hits 58-Year High
The Census Bureau reported that [median household income](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6wwxj8ULiJF7m7alBaGsZlcFixmvKt9-8h5hbTnk845-n5_rV8OE-bjl3vCzHtZM7wpATPUdYcQ8RsIM0MF4uoY6ECXV630IJWV7bg6z_iC1bgmzDuAhq6BuR0nO3S216qJs9lsmHwYJjMFP1qjwmhH027BgjHa-gbnu0_ZdmyV6lv7mHrT7RZ0GDobguqFURCQS338KZg5wp4-5QX14cuzSXNkPkl0P4RehF44QsSUbib0sl2EGYiEXk6oVLJLcsfssgehl0FZ1SsrL5KxXASxpCAx-_IEuVVw3yT7SX7AVXmTCr7UIDkCgTxquU6S5N53IDc8DiCWh8N8r4lu4a3CLrqf8WzqHM43poQ0jMKo4-nw38OG_1P6a9Z_AwAA__8BL5jO) rose 2.6% to $87,460 in 2025, the highest on record since tracking began in 1967. That is about $2,250 a year more than the year before. The gains were not evenly spread. The [top 10% of households](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu2yAYxfGnwRsRfMR2PDCkrdhulw5VJ4vAsU0vhghIrLx9lb7CnY909Nfv98f8YUMMaf1pd-i25DnhqBGtocwL_BY-UUNqKKit2Ia6BptmEjRwMXE5zta18MR8tp3XC0BQHbQcL9Ogpp5Et2lxcwusuggIujjnl9HJ8TYMveyFFKS6oN9_YpKjFKKX0-nSn9UygfygJu9Fz84CPrRcTn9zSG3DEl_5iXJyee-i3lq7V6aujAwjcxzHaa_pvTEySPxRGZk9J7wYmRUJxUZGZsuPii1Hz0NyeQffQqu8wOXi-e3ReMwHCoctCaXymCv4WvIjeUbGFn69kvv8Lv8wZbILnqkf396OOOovlHtXtL8fIcZQh5GdxbrbEP_3ti8yPzX9CwAA__8EhJQe) saw income rise 1.7% to about $261,300, while the bottom 10% saw no meaningful change at roughly $20,000. The official poverty rate fell for a third straight year to [10.2%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uxCAUhE-DO1sY_AMFRRp3mzalxcLDkGCw4K2tvX3kXCH1SN_MfF-P9aFDDGn71DsodHlNcNUIiFBWB9aHH6ghIRSoWDRC3YJOK6Nsaqls-3nVBsMJ66AbqxwAA96A6mchJy5HRhuvejFrLowF457OaSnswAcr5unJrRFCN0HdPCr7uad07GUnxoE7CcxOXFpLRzJQsAFz6b5zSOjBxXc-oXQm701UHvGohH8QthC2XNfVGUj1Vbstn4Qt96OS807YchSotS0QQVeohC13MWFLSCbv0B43FN-tBx3RtyHVV9HJQGvuQG_QedxjU5Q9rhBjqNNMBrrtOsS_KfhPg6divwEAAP__CvaJCg), and child poverty hit a record low. A broader measure that counts medical bills and housing costs held steady at 13.1%. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent labeled the numbers, from 2025 data, "[inconvenient facts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2uozAQhuGrMR3IP2DjwsVKK7psuyUy9hBmY-wIzwbl7o-IdK7g1CM9mvf7e5tvHhPm-x-_g6O1zBnOmoAIjnmFuOEDKmaCAyodnqDe0edZcqlbblthZh8IXzD3voluBZCgGnDCjFYrO0jebG7Vg-25l6NZehvDYnUIShhlw6hNH8cG3eVxK4zgfBC2G4derRZk1MrGyAfWc4hI5ej-Fcy0wZre5QVHF8reJLcRPStTv5icmJzO8-xCXsJ1ZHK6aCYnbpmcxMDkhDmUHdrnBdC7DZDr_9quENvvzvYT2m20J6amvZbwwMjUb64GMy7jIoI1OiyaK6UtCBDRRx2Vbw4XnyemhFUb1vP77jF9fqQfTvty8isAAP__WZ-LYw)" for the administration's political opponents during House testimony.

I've met thousands of people in the district, and almost all have been polite, respectful, and supportive. ALMOST ALL...
I met a man in LaFayette and told him I was running for Congress. We talked, and he said he liked what I was saying, especially that I wanted to help LaFayette fix its water system so the water from the faucet didn't run brown. He asked me if I was a Republican. I said no; I'm a Democrat. He looked at me and said he would never vote for me. "Why not?" I asked. He said, "It's the gay thing. You Democrats talk too much about the gays."
I'm running to represent that man.
There was a woman in Roanoke. She told me Chuck Schumer was evil. She said not only was Barack Obama evil, but he was also a Muslim. She told me if I was a Democrat, I was evil.
Yeah, I'm running to represent her.
Even if I wanted to help only the people who voted for me, I couldn't. We can't just help Democrats earn a living wage. That's not how the economy works. We can't just help the people who voted for me get better healthcare. We can't just help the children of Democrats have better schools. We can't get clean drinking water to just the Democrats in a town. Even if we could, it wouldn't be right.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
This week, we paused to mark the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks. The memory of that trauma is difficult for many, but we need to remember that the trauma did not end that day.

First responders who selflessly worked "The Pile," searching for survivors and clearing the site, are still suffering from illnesses linked to that work. The wars that followed in response to those attacks have left many coping with injuries that are both seen and unseen.
As a disabled veteran, I have some understanding of the cost these great people are still paying for their service to the United States, and I state without hesitation that I will fight so that they all receive the honors and care they deserve.
It's 49 days until the general election on November 3rd.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

## Family Sues Paxton after Pregnancy Death
The family of a 37-year-old San Antonio woman who died 20 weeks into her pregnancy [sued Attorney General Ken Paxton](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykULuuozAQ_RrTObIHL1wKim3c3W23RBN7ACt-RPYkhL9fsb9wu6NzpPP6-718Y4ghb38w0cyftSyZjhaJmepy4JnKE-sj5I2DexC3DVR7pQUUDFJNUo8LOg5vWgx2fr4rP-mOZj1-TYOBSalun780Gr2OiqD3blBmNYPvDZkRnO4dqC7Ml52a9Ki10j3c7og0Ovg1woBTr-7CKPKBS73xTkwfbGs8y5vqzZXUxXlnfjbR_xZgBdjjOG6PhnyJAuy1R4CNxWEUYK8oAVZNAqy-UEO5YgrxlO1FTT4oyyd-uGT5yuFNtQU-5U4YeZepVJJrqbLS-mohbxLvpXIoWUZCfxFcZCq8U23SE_IuwHZ19s8jxBjaMAqjtoQh_q_OP738PcO_AAAA__8CAJep), University Health, and six other defendants Tuesday in Bexar County. Tierra Walker died Dec. 30, 2024, of [hypertensive heart disease with preeclampsia](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGypCAURVeDGRY8USQwmMTsTzqh9cCnTX0UC95vu3c_1bOFWcC9dc7587V8YUzx3H_jQRO_trycdNdEzFSWG99HvrB8x3PnGL6J6w6q_hwLKBikclLbBQPHJy0Gm3XyanW6oUnb0Q0GnFLNY9JDR673xm4WtFPeO4JVb1vX96Efx66J0-dOOW21VrqD1iOSDdBbGNB1ygujaI2cS8sPYnph3dI7P6m0IR9Nmh7MVxXdLwGzgPm-7zb4ql3LTwEzFo4hkYD5YyZgTjlgEjBfhSgkPK4aUV6F9hPP8JYJ7_oTWaLPhWM-5ZoD5_JZgu2ktsE5S1p6D5s0oI0cRzPIdQyw2bHr0eimTOt1x5RiHawwaj8wpn-s_L-NnxP8DQAA__-ynY9P). She lost twins to the same condition in 2021. Walker asked for an abortion when she suffered seizures and blood clots, and was told "nothing is wrong with the baby," the lawsuit says. It accuses Paxton and Texas Medical Board executive director Stephen Brint Carlton of a "merciless blanket prohibition" on abortion. University Health said it can't discuss the case, but that its priority is timely, appropriate care. Paxton's office hasn't commented. The Texas Medical Board said doctors are "[not required to wait](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdEZrQwwULq6h-6-9Ei2wgIXByN7EydufyCv83UijmdF8_36GH3TenetfPMjyewnDSTl5YqY4ZPwc4cK4u3NlN-3EadWQnsegQRsJnVTNgBO7Fw01FrMdYe5UQVY1bWdq3QEUm52ADLZmedTqYeYG6pZg7LBaxhZJmbpw9q6DTjVKgap0OSJSM-lHow12FYyiBpodh1jyRkxvTIv_hBfFcgpH4e3GfCVR_RG6F7rPOZfTmO4fty90f0uh-29S4hgiu3DKmZA36TGnp2PJjmJEmdHvFOVOp7zwzeEUui-ina_svHfJNKKG9UDnv9P8W2Qvq_8HAAD__-iYg0I) until a mother's life is in immediate danger or her major bodily function is at immediate risk before providing necessary medical care." They added that in some circumstances, such care "may include the termination of a pregnancy."
## Waymo Racks Up 123 Austin Tickets
Waymo's driverless cars collected [123 parking tickets in Austin](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OuzAMwPGnCVtQYighQ4bfwtbfeiMywaUR4Y-I27Rvf-JU3Qvc7K9sffx17a8YYlin_7iQ49dt61fKKRIzHX3G97LteMxhnTj4mThNoNJj6UFBI5WV2vToOTypr7EY3aBGqwty2rS2qcEqVdyd90Z7c8EKsTJklb6MYIdWNYhALbVFcOc6ZbXRWukKygGRjIeLgQZtpQZRKxoDb0fJd2J6YbrF9_ako_TbUkR3Z96TqP4J6AR0OedyfuF6DgV0p0dAFzePUUCHj8RhPbMTJw_0c5KPXWqo5IcqP1YZVvmbF4cb9xxiDKkxolbTgiH-3Oe__u3p4DsAAP__x3uDlQ) between August 2024 and July 2026, more than any other robotaxi company operating in Central Texas. Sixty-nine citations came from tow-away zones, 14 from unpaid meters, and 10 from double parking. City transportation official Lewis Leff said the cars sometimes stay at the curb or in travel lanes longer than usual during pickups and drop-offs. Waymo said it pays tickets like any other driver and keeps refining its software. Austin logged [eight robotaxi crashes](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOpC9GBMXLq6h-6-9Ei32AlYMjuxNSN7-RF7hb0YjjTSj-f79TD8YYjjWv7iT5feSpoPOEomZ8nTiZ08PzPdwrBzcnbisIMpzn0CAboRp5DCh4_CiSWHt7Sy8kTVZOdyMVmCEqDcLCMbppSfvBSx9Rw6duclOeKelxq4O9qoTRg5SCtlBOyPS4KAfQKPpxFwpQT5wyi1vxPTGssRPelFuXdrraDfmR6m6PxWMFYznebYf3FK60grG61AF4_MSzBxcpK99Fg5HE9NamluT05wY36FxGctGpZFaCdWrTrUb77HO1j_OEGMoeqiUWHcM8bvOv6X2svA_AAD__67NglA) in the four weeks ending Aug. 17, including one in which a garbage truck backed into a Waymo. Tesla's gold Cybercabs, which have no steering wheel or pedals, launched in Austin on Sept. 3 and have since reached Dallas, Houston, and [now San Antonio](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvO4yAQhZ8Gd1gwvhAXFNu4y7ZbWgMeOygYIpiNk7dfeV_h7450pO9c_tyXO4YY0v4bD7L82fKS6KyRmKksJ36P_MLyDGnn4J_EdQdV_x4LKBilmqQ2C3oOb1p6bFbr1Drphqw2t2nsYVKqeViEwZt1xJsfOtRmXN1G2m_9beg39H5ogr1watJGa6U7aB0iGQ-DgRGnTjnRK1oD59Lyg5g-WLf4zW8qrc9HE-2D-VVF90vALGA-z7N9VuTLFDBfewTMMXuMAuYrSsCsJgGzvhRTjSj911Hx6GTJLjN-QpU-HyHtkrOsmCQmzilkWbkQ8UVsil1fZ4gx1NGIXu0Hhvi_Ef_0ybeFfwEAAP__4BWJMg). Waymo's service there has been paused since April, when one of its cars drove through a flooded intersection.
## State Shuts Down Trinidad Police
The state is shutting down [the police department in Trinidad](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO4zAMRU8jdwwkxmOPChfbuJtttzRok06ESJYhcZLx7RfOFaYjQOC9__-_r-mLQgzb7S8lGfRnzdMmrxpFVcr0oiPlncojbDcNy0O03tDW7zShxQ6sB9dPtGh4ytRSw8Ns2btGBtd_-q5Fb21zH3D2vKJYRqaOsf_oZv6k1knX-nb1axOGE2e9652z7oqXmUj6BT967Mhf7WxaKxw0l4veReWH6hqP_JRyWXJq4nBX3au5_jE4Ghy3Y89Vz5fB8SQbHK03OLrz-q5wNjQ4vkGw5xgWAZadiibZFPROClSKVBWGlBOcKuBQ9IAXqRRYaZE55wecJsiFpQiDZuBQZ9oY5gOqkorBsSkD768QY6hdb1p7SxTiO7j-dvDngP8DAAD__yFhmBM) on Friday, four months after officers in the East Texas town arrested a woman over a Facebook post about the city's water. As Florida public records reviewed by [Loomered.com](https://substack.com/redirect/3498a8b8-a5ad-4a76-a796-d7dc091f4c7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reveal, Florida's Democrat nominee for the United States Senate comes from a family with repeated run-ins with the criminal justice system, and the man she is married to is one of them.

Court files from Duval County, Florida, identify Nixon's father, her brother, and her husband as defendants in a series of criminal cases spanning nearly three decades. The charges range from battery on a law enforcement officer and domestic battery to driving under the influence, leaving the scene of a crash, resisting arrest, and a criminal traffic citation issued the day after Nixon's infamous megaphone stunt on the floor of the Florida House.
The records document a multi-generational pattern of arrests, pleas, injunctions, and criminal traffic cases among Nixon's immediate family.

Court records identify Anthony Nixon, Angie Nixon's father, as the defendant in a 1997 Duval County felony case in which he was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer, resisting an officer with violence, and domestic battery. The battery on a law enforcement officer count was later dropped. On the charge of resisting an officer with violence, records show he plead guilty, with adjudication withheld, and received probation and jail time. The domestic battery charge produced a guilty finding.

---|---|---
Her brother, Anthony Nixon II, appears in Duval County court records as the respondent in a petition for injunction for protection against domestic violence filed on June 15, 2021. The petitioner, who identified Nixon II as his nephew and stated that the two had lived in the same home "as if a family," asked the court to protect him from Angie Nixon's brother. According to the records, the case resulted in a final judgment of injunction against Nixon's brother.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4eb8b6c3-2383-478f-a4af-147f69810b31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That was not his only encounter with police. Records show Nixon II was arrested after a crash on charges of driving under the influence, leaving the scene of an accident, and resisting an officer without violence. He was later arrested again on a battery charge, this time while his sister was already serving as a member of the Florida House of Representatives.
Then there is the man Angie Nixon is still married to. As Loomer Unleashed [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/ba7bb5d8-4d84-45cb-afd5-c98127ce5dae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Nixon filed for divorce from Jarrett Vanness Morene Sr. in September 2024, let the case sit on the docket for nearly two years, and then quietly dismissed it in a late-night filing six days after winning her primary. Morene's own record helps explain why the Nixon campaign might prefer that voters not look too closely at him.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..bdJzIY8uFd_wbglN4OWQ--yjVqZRhlY8rTmYFyHKpSw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=215829765)
Court files show Morene has a DUI conviction after a guilty plea that included jail time, probation, and a license revocation. Subsequent criminal files list additional criminal-traffic cases and a violation of probation, for which he was arrested.
On April 29, 2026, Nixon disrupted the Florida House during the vote on the state's new congressional map by blasting a pink megaphone on the chamber floor, a stunt that left Republican State Rep. Yvette Benarroch [seeking medical treatment for possible ear damage](https://substack.com/redirect/f4a552b8-a659-4b00-9d6b-0189ddb98743?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and filing a workers' compensation claim. The House later [formally reprimanded Nixon](https://substack.com/redirect/b493cde9-70e9-4b4e-b0ab-8b5f76ed29db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the outburst.
The very next morning, April 30, 2026, at 8:46 a.m., the Florida Highway Patrol pulled Morene over on SR 111 at Post Street in Jacksonville and cited him for operating a 1992 Ford pickup truck with no motor vehicle registration, a violation of Florida Statute 320.02(1). The citation was marked as a criminal violation requiring a court appearance, with a court date of May 29, 2026, in Duval County Traffic Court.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/16cd75ad-9bf0-4bc5-bc63-c9abd456d144?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While Angie Nixon was making national headlines for screaming through a bullhorn at her colleagues, her husband was being written up by state troopers for a criminal traffic offense. Both incidents occurred while Nixon was a sitting state representative in Florida, and a declared candidate for the United States Senate.
On May 15, 2026, Nixon herself was [arrested by the Florida Department of Law Enforcement](https://substack.com/redirect/4aaaedef-c614-4f47-858c-06d815a1dd6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after a five-hour sit-in outside Governor Ron DeSantis' office in the Florida State Capitol. She now faces open misdemeanor charges of trespassing and resisting an officer without violence. Her court date is scheduled for October 12, 2026, in Tallahassee.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ec112a2f-2c60-470e-9140-9527b5f48867?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Add that to Angie Nixon's record Loomered.com has already exposed: a decade of "careless driving" citations that culminated in a 2019 crash in which [Nixon drove into oncoming traffic and injured her own minor daughter](https://substack.com/redirect/181bba44-6073-4428-9281-092ba49215ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and a communist-themed Jacksonville cafe that has been [operating on a delinquent state food license](https://substack.com/redirect/ce6cf122-6f1e-4b32-b03c-9bb0dc0e2394?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The rules, it seems, are for other people, and never for Angie Nixon and her family members.
Since securing the nomination against Alex Vindman on August 18 and winning the [immediate backing of the DSCC](https://substack.com/redirect/a91a7316-40e2-47c7-821b-8509b77de75d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Nixon has campaigned on "demilitarizing the police" and, [according to her own campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/4752a144-723b-4897-bcb0-43fddecf3de5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), on "abolishing ICE." She has compared federal immigration agents to ["modern-day slave catchers."](https://substack.com/redirect/b6038a5b-026f-4c2e-a3db-1fbe7a3084fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A candidate whose father pleaded guilty to resisting an officer with violence, whose brother was arrested for DUI and battery and hit with a domestic violence injunction, and whose husband has a DUI conviction and a fresh criminal traffic citation is now asking Floridians to hand her federal power so she can make the criminal justice system softer.
Angie Nixon is anti-police, anti-law and order, pro-open borders, and pro-criminal. The records show it runs in the family, and Florida voters should keep that in mind this November when they head to the polls.

Dear Friend,

_" I rang the doorbell, and a lady answered."_

That's how Grace's story starts.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=c12fc26cab4a4adbbdf990bd7e29ee64&_e=VzTN_rHN2hHp_m0ffHRgnYKE2cdwxk7cA-iA6NDG-Q06Nn_I4HRBOZeSySsaipMQU6Sr6NSEI3jL-WwS6h-qFUXfFTovADjzRejKPin1OgY-g1fP6-tdXXhwkkKEKM8us1Ii6ZVOcOQC1ceOqTO2XE-htbDhnBu_npXRgXa_uFZEG8wqvvsPvhXFCknXmcbBXMXcg-eF9JM7V0jX0vyem1KF8-u0gtG9mJBvzC6pHybAibllN51rv2NldwhK7V4T51g8pevqMpAMJg4vDId7q01x5ESBxTnwtMSNVvk_fz7JSZ-fDzt-j0rP7NCIxxVhx06xWwi-UAsofBldFPHMXQ2I8GIXnqh3JaEDqfSgJVXOsRW2c-Ll1auwgUJ6TWkW6sM5mP9Z3s0Zi38_K2roHDivbrB2MktlqKi6AsxG1oxP5ptM4TLA0BnkCa99ktMkIC0UUTtMkTR8WVtWvUPDo-sTh26HbBGGqbZEIRh-YbcuVVFPNDrP6JVo__P3edK_HGxgJneHX4EVo71PVmnSGEOzc8tmEDaXHlFRjNhPWyAVe1F-mpnExejhwsD1DHnQdyN05r1cn5Y2ButSW80wOdT7HJIqgW5wMQcCtEMGvJo_PkyLubU7oEDKKMYLttgJ)

She introduced herself. Told the woman she was volunteering to protect preborn babies. Asked politely if she could count on her vote.

The woman said "no, thank you." Grace said have a good day and turned to leave.

**That 's when someone screamed from inside the house. A second woman ran out the door - she chased Grace down the driveway, shoved her, and hit her in the head with both fists.**

As Grace tried to run away and reached the end of the driveway, the woman threw a dinner roll that hit her in the face - **and kept following her down the street, screaming that she hoped Grace would be run over by a car.**

Grace filed a police report. The woman was arrested and charged.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Friend, this is just one story from one of Students for Life Action's door-to-door canvassers during the last midterm election.

I've told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two months.

I wish I could tell you Grace's story was a one-off. It isn't. Doors get slammed. Voices get raised. Sometimes it gets violent.

And yet our canvassers keep walking up the next driveway because they know if the Abortion Lobby seizes power in November, it will be a death sentence to millions more innocent preborn babies.

**_[Friend, will you please prayerfully consider sending a Care Package to one of our door-to-door canvassers heading into the field this fall](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=c12fc26cab4a4adbbdf990bd7e29ee64&_e=VzTN_rHN2hHp_m0ffHRgnYKE2cdwxk7cA-iA6NDG-Q06Nn_I4HRBOZeSySsaipMQU6Sr6NSEI3jL-WwS6h-qFUXfFTovADjzRejKPin1OgY-g1fP6-tdXXhwkkKEKM8us1Ii6ZVOcOQC1ceOqTO2XE-htbDhnBu_npXRgXa_uFbcLMxj2J8jrAza1ObU6hPVpEOQv067NirUkdQ0uwXCg-dvH23nv8UYooE0fjHOJaAzJ7e2JExaYBMqe4GLcYmO8y0qXJBN2XAk-vhbCsrfrX7lsqq1Ti097TegThNSFoCWCMY-aqzxMmTA2QT2u0qw_JNTRZ2S_T-gNyWFUmDLCzXme0gZPki7nSKFnCYFLEWwm3y2Bam1IMiTGTwCXbiP69bYrcTvIJICFrZ--7tCYIpWiv5jJaN6nChxmQtQNwjAqJnmUV7-SAvTcn7q6cvjYJfupojjmm-Yh2H_Wf5V7WgMTyj31OCxgrQPHNG8lZGb28eHSIysSy-tCfmlcY5mUOGg3KGGt34hBjCqO0unV6uVMyLYPS_WRXcCv0jDoZG3ja0e3bs_FguEykE4SXa7-LdzDNQcz3OzwGFxSDY7y_kOmDrIu_XlysMIOPbt8wKghvAMs5KTBzyZJYV2F5f5vg1p64jyWOGMFVExanEZBQ%3D%3D)_**?

These young women and men will be walking for hours in scorching heat. Knowing pro-lifers like you have their backs will help keep them going.

Of course, I could tell our door-knockers to go home.

I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead.

But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad, mailer, or text ever could - and the effect doesn't disappear after one election.

**Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote pro-life again in the _next_ election cycle, too.**

_And, it only costs us about $3 for every door we knock._

Not only that, but we'll be deploying teams of pro-life activists to blanket church parking lots with flyers exposing the records of pro-abortion politicians in key districts every Sunday in September and October.

This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that's needed to turn out every pro-life voter.

Last cycle, this approach worked.

***** In Oklahoma,** our student canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion senators who killed our Chemical Abortion Pill Trafficking Bill - and voters threw them out.

***** In South Carolina,** we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who protected the _Life at Conception Act 's_ enemies - and they lost too.

***** In North Carolina,** 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries outright.

That's just a small sample of what our door-to-door canvassing team has done over the years. The Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than for our students to stay home this fall.

Right now, we're already deployed and expanding over the next two months, where this election gets decided door by door. Our target map for the 2026 Midterms is the most ambitious we've run:

**> >> Idaho and Missouri** - ballot referendum battles where the Abortion Lobby is trying to buy a win at the ballot box.

**> >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas** - U.S. Senate races that could decide who controls the chamber.

**> >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Ohio, North Carolina, Pennsylvania** - Gubernatorial and state legislative races that will shape abortion law for years.

**> >> California's 13th, Iowa's 3rd, Michigan's 10th, Pennsylvania's 10th, North Carolina's 1st, Ohio's 9th, and Texas's 34th** - U.S. House battlegrounds where a few thousand doors could flip a seat and determine control of Congress.

We'll be active in at least ten states in races up and down the ballots. And every single one of them needs boots on the ground before Tuesday, November 3rd.

Friend, the Abortion Lobby has the money, the media, and the institutions. What they don't have is thousands of young pro-lifers willing to knock on a stranger's door, get yelled at, sometimes get hit with worse than words - and go knock on the next door anyway.

That grit and determination is what wins elections.

**_[So, will you please prayerfully consider making your most generous contribution to fund our canvassers as they head into the two most important months of this election](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=c12fc26cab4a4adbbdf990bd7e29ee64&_e=VzTN_rHN2hHp_m0ffHRgnYKE2cdwxk7cA-iA6NDG-Q06Nn_I4HRBOZeSySsaipMQU6Sr6NSEI3jL-WwS6h-qFUXfFTovADjzRejKPin1OgY-g1fP6-tdXXhwkkKEKM8us1Ii6ZVOcOQC1ceOqTO2XE-htbDhnBu_npXRgXa_uFZFbdYp2NlpSV2BkQtZzxN3kd7hVPpaG1fLv2S0n7gI0emWHwGqEZa2A9aPcjOfOr-WbqNODezZpcDyj9dk3Jcu_hmGq2YpPeVrmTyASukU5fT_qJuY9uWF5Om52Fz_wilAcF9W7tJE-Z_d-dyHREKtR3XrXarFcuWg0E_6_YNmMCvzy1mq297RCvo3j-zKejpmpnAb76tIqA4OM8WQ2Zpoh6jgVlPQlUssBAhWSMYGb7xAbGItcf4zdKY1YH0_t6xcau9hIlXxpAb1tZEX6-Q9CCqyjc4PeLH3U5PjMH94ty2mXWx6GQeLDnhIjFM07qsow4sABV6TztfjvY1OWdC8arRaihMD-sipCg02pkkkqeH4rykSeeqYy2QU44lAFgZSVHmfB_nwFgajZQd1BG9_lS8TQxOKqFzYzIesLDcb_lIBIK0515T_8roAkKqAMDM8QG6cWVehhcGjJ20goGgriVrUIDJsg2ZjxymIVaH4xA%3D%3D)_**?

**> >> $1,200** fully funds FIVE pro-life canvassers for an entire day in the field - roughly 400 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $240** fully funds a canvasser's entire day in the field - roughly 80 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $70** covers a canvasser's gas for a full weekend of door-knocking.

**> >> $50** puts a canvassing team through a full Church Parking Lot Blitz weekend - flyers, printing, and all.

**> >> $25** pays for a canvasser's meals for a day in the field.

Grace didn't quit after that driveway. And this fall, our students won't quit either.

But they need to know you're behind them.

Kristan Hawkins

clean_body: Dear Friend, " I rang the doorbell, and a lady answered." That's how Grace's story starts. She introduced herself. Told the woman she was volunteering to protect preborn babies. Asked politely if she could count on her vote. The woman said "no, thank you." Grace said have a good day and turned to leave. That 's when someone screamed from inside the house. A second woman ran out the door - she chased Grace down the driveway, shoved her, and hit her in the head with both fists. As Grace tried to run away and reached the end of the driveway, the woman threw a dinner roll that hit her in the face - and kept following her down the street, screaming that she hoped Grace would be run over by a car. Grace filed a police report. The woman was arrested and charged. My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement. Friend, this is just one story from one of Students for Life Action's door-to-door canvassers during the last midterm election. I've told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two months. I wish I could tell you Grace's story was a one-off. It isn't. Doors get slammed. Voices get raised. Sometimes it gets violent. And yet our canvassers keep walking up the next driveway because they know if the Abortion Lobby seizes power in November, it will be a death sentence to millions more innocent preborn babies. ? These young women and men will be walking for hours in scorching heat. Knowing pro-lifers like you have their backs will help keep them going. Of course, I could tell our door-knockers to go home. I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead. But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad, mailer, or text ever could - and the effect doesn't disappear after one election. Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote pro-life again in the next election cycle, too. And, it only costs us about $3 for every door we knock. Not only that, but we'll be deploying teams of pro-life activists to blanket church parking lots with flyers exposing the records of pro-abortion politicians in key districts every Sunday in September and October. This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that's needed to turn out every pro-life voter. Last cycle, this approach worked. *** In Oklahoma, our student canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion senators who killed our Chemical Abortion Pill Trafficking Bill - and voters threw them out. *** In South Carolina, we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who protected the Life at Conception Act 's enemies - and they lost too. *** In North Carolina, 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries outright. That's just a small sample of what our door-to-door canvassing team has done over the years. The Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than for our students to stay home this fall. Right now, we're already deployed and expanding over the next two months, where this election gets decided door by door. Our target map for the 2026 Midterms is the most ambitious we've run: >> Idaho and Missouri - ballot referendum battles where the Abortion Lobby is trying to buy a win at the ballot box. >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas - U.S. Senate races that could decide who controls the chamber. >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Ohio, North Carolina, Pennsylvania - Gubernatorial and state legislative races that will shape abortion law for years. >> California's 13th, Iowa's 3rd, Michigan's 10th, Pennsylvania's 10th, North Carolina's 1st, Ohio's 9th, and Texas's 34th - U.S. House battlegrounds where a few thousand doors could flip a seat and determine control of Congress. We'll be active in at least ten states in races up and down the ballots. And every single one of them needs boots on the ground before Tuesday, November 3rd. Friend, the Abortion Lobby has the money, the media, and the institutions. What they don't have is thousands of young pro-lifers willing to knock on a stranger's door, get yelled at, sometimes get hit with worse than words - and go knock on the next door anyway. That grit and determination is what wins elections. ? >> $1,200 fully funds FIVE pro-life canvassers for an entire day in the field - roughly 400 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time. >> $240 fully funds a canvasser's entire day in the field - roughly 80 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time. >> $70 covers a canvasser's gas for a full weekend of door-knocking. >> $50 puts a canvassing team through a full Church Parking Lot Blitz weekend - flyers, printing, and all. >> $25 pays for a canvasser's meals for a day in the field. Bab el-Mandeb -- Arabic for "Gate of Tears" -- is the narrow throat separating Yemen on the Arabian Peninsula from Djibouti and Eritrea on the Horn of Africa. It spans roughly 14 miles at its narrowest, and Perim Island splits the passage into two shipping channels barely a couple of miles wide each. Every vessel entering or leaving the Red Sea must funnel through it: south to the Gulf of Aden, the Arabian Sea, and the refineries of Asia; north to the Suez Canal, the Mediterranean, and Europe. It is the only maritime door between the Indian Ocean and the Mediterranean short of sailing around the entire African continent.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/083ff933-c8e3-4065-be87-2043ca4c26a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**What the Lanes Carry**
At its 2023 peak, the U.S. Energy Information Administration counted about 8.7 million barrels per day of crude, condensate, and refined products moving through the strait -- roughly 9 percent of all seaborne petroleum. The Houthi attack campaign that began in late 2023 gutted that figure: by the first half of 2025, about 4.2 million barrels per day were transiting Bab el-Mandeb, with another 4.9 million through the Suez Canal and the SUMED pipeline at the Red Sea's northern end. Together those routes carried only about 6 percent of the world's seaborne oil -- down from roughly 12 percent of global trade and 30 percent of container traffic in calmer years.
But 2026 flipped the story. As the Strait of Hormuz -- which normally handles about 20 percent of the world's oil, some 20 million barrels daily -- sat essentially closed through most of the past five months of the Iran war, the Red Sea became the workaround. EIA data show crude and condensate through Bab el-Mandeb climbing from 3.7 million barrels per day in the first quarter of 2025 to 5.4 million in the first quarter of 2026, and LNG flows -- which had halted entirely in mid-2025 -- recovering to 2.9 billion cubic feet per day.
**Hormuz 's Relief Valve**
Here is the point most Americans miss: Bab el-Mandeb is not a rival to Hormuz. It is Hormuz's escape hatch. Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline carries crude across the kingdom to Yanbu on the Red Sea, bypassing the Persian Gulf entirely. When Hormuz choked this year, Riyadh turned that valve wide open. Kpler tracking data show Yanbu exporting about 4.1 million barrels per day in June -- roughly 64 percent of the Saudi oil that otherwise would have left the Gulf. Those barrels had only one way to Asia: south through Bab el-Mandeb, around the Horn of Africa, into the Indian Ocean.
The strait is also strategic infrastructure beyond oil: 12 to 15 submarine fiber-optic cables carrying an estimated 15 to 18 percent of global internet traffic hug the same corridor, and Djibouti's port is the lifeline for Ethiopian grain imports.
**The Squeeze**
On July 20, 2026, with Hormuz still not fully normalized, the Houthis announced a blockade targeting Bab el-Mandeb itself -- attacking the very corridor that had been serving as the escape route, one carrying about 7 percent of global oil supply. Tanker operators once again faced the calculus of 2024: missile attacks, drone strikes, hijackings, and war-risk insurance premiums that spiked from a few hundredths of a percent of hull value to roughly ten times that. Egypt, for reference, lost about $7 billion in Suez Canal revenue in 2024 alone when ships fled this corridor.
**If It Closes**
The alternative is the Cape of Good Hope, which handles about 9.1 million barrels per day -- but the Cape only helps oil that is already outside the Red Sea. Rerouting from Southeast Asia to Europe around Africa adds roughly 3,500 to 4,000 miles and ten to fourteen days, with fuel costs near $1 million extra per voyage at recent bunker prices.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6bc4eb88-3038-4855-a94f-05a2e03d314b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For Asian buyers, the math is brutal. Gulf crude normally reaches Asia through Hormuz in under a week. With Hormuz compromised, that oil detours through the Red Sea. If Bab el-Mandeb closes too, those 4 to 5 million barrels per day are functionally landlocked -- Yanbu tankers cannot sail south, and the Suez-to-Mediterranean route serves Europe, not Asia. The result is a bidding war among the world's largest importers for a suddenly shrunken pool of Atlantic Basin and West African barrels, with Brent pushed well into triple digits under nearly every bank scenario. Expect cascading effects: spot LNG prices soaring, freight rates tripling as in 2024, European inflation re-accelerating, and strategic reserves -- already thin after repeated drawdowns -- draining fast.
**The Point**
The world's oil system depends on two pinches of water, and they are married to each other. Hormuz is the main gate; Bab el-Mandeb, via the pipelines to Yanbu and Fujairah, is the fire exit. In 2026 both doors have been slammed at once. A world that let one chokepoint -- guarded by a militia in flip-flops on Yemen's coast -- throttle 9 percent of seaborne oil has learned the lesson the hard way: diversity of supply means nothing without diversity of routes. Until more pipeline capacity, more friendly terminals, and a credible naval umbrella exist, every crisis from Tehran to Sana'a will be priced into the pump in Peoria.

name: Team Gina
subject: Abbott’s response to Medicaid cuts
body:
Texas hospitals have lost nearly $10 billion.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
In a last-ditch effort, Greg Abbott is fighting back to recover the nearly $10 billion lost as a result of the Trump Administration’s Medicaid cuts.
However, hardworking Texans have already been feeling the burden of Medicaid cuts.
4 million Texans are enrolled in Medicaid, with the vast majority being children. Texas deserves better than someone who waits around while children lose access to healthcare — until his control of the governorship starts slipping.
**Greg Abbott _knew_ this would have critical impacts all across Texas** — hospitals across the state have been sounding the alarm for nearly a year. But only as he feels his ratings falling is he finally choosing to fight back.
Texas is one of only a few states that hasn’t expanded Medicaid to more low-income Texans. This was Abbott’s decision, leading Texas to have the highest uninsured rate in the nation.
**Texas needs a governor who will fight for all hardworking Texans from the very beginning** , not in a last-minute cleanup effort.
From day one, Gina is committed to protecting local hospitals and ensuring all Texans can get the healthcare they need.

subject: Can human nature be perfected simply by changing politics or economics?
body:
Is human nature fixed, or can it be changed? That question lies at the heart of some of the most consequential ideas in history.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuq2zAQQL9G3tno4cjOwotLncCF5pY2i3ZnZM3EHtALS7r9_RKa_kC35wxnYObnbbkZchS2D-NxopwXiLBYE_bqTQim1ANXTHg80BaERXKpW35uxbAYW-gTl940MJ2kGB9jg5MYxrPutZa82af-NKxSS7laUAgnPa5iHGE0PYqzwMfY0PTs8bMYhORKDR0XqFeh5UlYuXINrOc1gSnYUcgEmG2MKUVHhWzu4rE1btpLSZmpNyavTF4z2npgt5NzGYzDDqEyeYUYTMGnrynFo7Rlx5YcGWDqmnHzGMqXCMjUzBUX6oPLXn69zPO3-XK5M6lr8UuO9bDPkXTEnNAWCttLeQSqnqkZvSH3gtb4ZGgLTM1_V71wDAVDYWq-vf349X6_Ld-H9v1-b_8dozkmSL_JOcp6YD3fns3ORt-U_33R5yT_BAAA__9Q_KGD)

| | Dear Fellow American, **Is human nature fixed, or can it be changed?** That question lies at the heart of some of the most consequential ideas in history. Karl Marx believed that if society could be upended, mankind itself could be remade. That promise inspired revolutionary movements throughout the twentieth century—with catastrophic consequences, as communist regimes claimed the lives of more than 100 million people. **Sadly, we’re seeing a resurgence of this destructive ideology right here in the United States.** But anyone who’s read Homer understands something far different. Nearly **3,000 years ago** , _The Iliad_ portrayed men and women with the same hopes, fears, loves, jealousies, ambitions, courage, and grief that we recognize today. Open its pages, and you discover something remarkable: **Human nature has not changed.** Near the end of the poem, King Priam of Troy enters the camp of Achilles, the warrior who killed his beloved son Hector. The old king kneels before his enemy and begs for his son’s body. Achilles thinks of his own aging father, and both men weep together. Every parent understands that scene. Every son can understand it. Across three millennia, Homer reminds us that what is deepest in human nature remains the same. That is why _The Iliad_ has endured as one of the foundational works of Western civilization. And it is one reason Hillsdale College created our free online course, **“The Iliad.”** The course introduces students to truths about courage, honor, sacrifice, friendship, justice, and duty—truths that every generation must rediscover if liberty is to endure. Those same truths also expose the false promise behind every utopian ideology: **that human nature can somehow be perfected simply by changing politics or economics.** **Will you make a tax-deductible gift today to help us introduce 100,000 Americans to these timeless lessons through Hillsdale’s free online course on _The Iliad_?** Will you help? Your gift of $25, $50, $100, or even $200 or more will go a long way toward this effort. **Please make your best, tax-deductible gift today using this secure link:** [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/donate/support-the-iliad**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuq2zAQQL9G3tno4cjOwotLncCF5pY2i3ZnZM3EHtALS7r9_RKa_kC35wxnYObnbbkZchS2D-NxopwXiLBYE_bqTQim1ANXTHg80BaERXKpW35uxbAYW-gTl940MJ2kGB9jg5MYxrPutZa82af-NKxSS7laUAgnPa5iHGE0PYqzwMfY0PTs8bMYhORKDR0XqFeh5UlYuXINrOc1gSnYUcgEmG2MKUVHhWzu4rE1btpLSZmpNyavTF4z2npgt5NzGYzDDqEyeYUYTMGnrynFo7Rlx5YcGWDqmnHzGMqXCMjUzBUX6oPLXn69zPO3-XK5M6lr8UuO9bDPkXTEnNAWCttLeQSqnqkZvSH3gtb4ZGgLTM1_V71wDAVDYWq-vf349X6_Ld-H9v1-b_8dozkmSL_JOcp6YD3fns3ORt-U_33R5yT_BAAA__9Q_KGD) Today, more young Americans express favorable views of socialism than at any time in recent decades. Too many have never encountered the great books that reveal why attempts to remake human nature have always failed. **Education is the answer.** Through more than **50 free online courses** , Hillsdale College is introducing millions of Americans to the principles of liberty and the enduring truths of Western civilization. Like everything we do, this course was created **without accepting a single penny of taxpayer funding—not even indirect funding through student grants and loans.** That independence allows Hillsdale to teach the truth without political interference. But it also means we rely entirely on friends like you to carry these lessons to the Americans who need them most. Thank you for standing with Hillsdale College as we pursue truth, defend liberty, and help another generation discover one of civilization’s greatest books. Warm regards, Bill Gray ’01

Hillsdale College

====================================================================================

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The other day we dropped this hard-hitting image that’s already going viral, and it’s exposing the deadly scam Democratic socialists have been running on America for decades.
==============================================================================================================================================================================

They sold it as equality. They sold it as compassion. They sold it as the moral high ground. Then they poured concrete, strung barbed wire, posted guards with rifles, and shot their own people for wanting out. That is the truth they still try to bury. If a system is so good, nobody needs a wall to keep the citizens from running.


Walls like that are not about protection. They are about control. They exist when the state owns your labor, your speech, your family, and your future. East Germany did not build that barrier to keep invaders out. They built it to keep workers, parents, and young people from choosing a life they were not allowed to have. Every generation that forgets that lesson gets offered the same lie in a new wrapper.


America was not built on permission from the state. It was built by men and women who took responsibility, took risk, and refused to wait for a committee to assign them a life. That is why the American Dream still threatens every ideology that needs you dependent. When people are forged by work, faith, family, and discipline, they do not beg a government for meaning. They build it.


That’s why I wrote the Amazon bestseller "Men Are Forged, Not Found", to equip the next generation with the truth before it’s too late.
=======================================================================================================================================

Order your copy today (Kindle, Hardcover, Paperback, Audible, Apple books) and help forge strong young men and women who will reject socialism and rebuild this Republic.

🔥 Order your copy today.

Reject Socialism. Secure Our Future. America First ALWAYS. Welcome to the FORGE 🇺🇸
==================================================================================

Each one teach many.
====================

-Garrett

You can buy the book here 👇
===========================

Listen to this HOT GARBAGE from our Nanny Governor
==================================================

Whitmer just blamed tariffs and a war halfway around the world for your bills. Then she blamed Republicans for rubber stamping it.
==================================================================================================================================

She has run Michigan for eight years.
=====================================

Electricity rates jumped more than 30 percent on her watch. She signed a gas tax hike from 31 cents to 52.4 cents. That is a 69 percent increase. The budget blew up from the high 50 billions to over 80 billion. Only 38 percent of third graders can read at grade level. A 12 year low.
===========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

She wants you staring at Washington so you forget who did this.
===============================================================

She already fought. You already paid.
=====================================

We all are counting the days for the "Terrible 3" to be out of Michigan.....God Willing!
