---
| Peter—

[Yesterday, the Center for Reproductive Rights filed a groundbreaking new case challenging Oklahoma abortion bans.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139389495/647204808/1134457483?sourceid=1151597&utm_campaign=27emage-0904aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=oklahoma&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjlhOWVhYi1hYmIyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9kXiaSzkbYDKRKUDQEcu7qvbo5JCAutvPRKNTmcwhA=&emci=19a9dee8-feb1-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=1f9a9eab-abb2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=954237)

I am the co-lead attorney in this case, fighting on behalf of patients who were denied abortion care after receiving fatal fetal diagnoses. Our plaintiffs received the news that their pregnancies were not going to result in a child they could take home. What they needed in that moment was urgent, compassionate care. Instead, the state of Oklahoma kicked them when they were down.

We are arguing that these Oklahoma abortion bans violate the rights to life and liberty of pregnant people who receive a fatal fetal diagnosis. We're seeking relief for those families so that what happened to our plaintiffs doesn't happen again — to them or to anyone else in Oklahoma. [These laws are cruel and unjust and we're spearheading the legal fight.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139389496/647204809/1134457483?sourceid=1151597&utm_campaign=27emage-0904aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=oklahoma&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjlhOWVhYi1hYmIyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9kXiaSzkbYDKRKUDQEcu7qvbo5JCAutvPRKNTmcwhA=&emci=19a9dee8-feb1-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=1f9a9eab-abb2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=954237) | [Fight Back](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139389497/647204810/1134457483?sourceid=1151597&utm_campaign=27emage-0904aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=oklahoma&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjlhOWVhYi1hYmIyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9kXiaSzkbYDKRKUDQEcu7qvbo5JCAutvPRKNTmcwhA=&emci=19a9dee8-feb1-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=1f9a9eab-abb2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=954237)
---
Joining our case are two physicians who have witnessed firsthand the devastating effects of Oklahoma's abortion bans. Despite their training and expertise, they are **unable to provide this basic medical care to their** patients without fear of criminal and civil penalties.

There is no excuse for the cruelty of denying care to families facing tragedy and heartbreak. [We're fighting to restore reproductive care for as many Oklahomans as possible and we'll continue that fight for as long as it takes.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139389498/647204811/1134457483?sourceid=1151597&utm_campaign=27emage-0904aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=oklahoma&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjlhOWVhYi1hYmIyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9kXiaSzkbYDKRKUDQEcu7qvbo5JCAutvPRKNTmcwhA=&emci=19a9dee8-feb1-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=1f9a9eab-abb2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=954237)

Our team will share updates as this case proceeds. For now, thank you for staying engaged and fighting by our side. [Your support makes our legal work possible.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139389499/647204812/1134457483?sourceid=1151597&utm_campaign=27emage-0904aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=oklahoma&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjlhOWVhYi1hYmIyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E9kXiaSzkbYDKRKUDQEcu7qvbo5JCAutvPRKNTmcwhA=&emci=19a9dee8-feb1-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=1f9a9eab-abb2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=954237)

In solidarity,

Caroline Sacerdote
Senior Staff Attorney

clean_body: The legal details behind yesterday's announcement | | | | | | Peter— I am the co-lead attorney in this case, fighting on behalf of patients who were denied abortion care after receiving fatal fetal diagnoses. Our plaintiffs received the news that their pregnancies were not going to result in a child they could take home. What they needed in that moment was urgent, compassionate care. Instead, the state of Oklahoma kicked them when they were down. We are arguing that these Oklahoma abortion bans violate the rights to life and liberty of pregnant people who receive a fatal fetal diagnosis. We're seeking relief for those families so that what happened to our plaintiffs doesn't happen again — to them or to anyone else in Oklahoma. | Joining our case are two physicians who have witnessed firsthand the devastating effects of Oklahoma's abortion bans. Despite their training and expertise, they are unable to provide this basic medical care to their patients without fear of criminal and civil penalties. There is no excuse for the cruelty of denying care to families facing tragedy and heartbreak. Our team will share updates as this case proceeds. For now, thank you for staying engaged and fighting by our side. Peter, I mentioned in my note to you last night that the team and I are working overtime. But in our rush we missed something important, and some typos are just more important than others. I shared that our final FEC quarterly reporting deadline was just two weeks away, and that was right. But **Early Voting in Texas begins on October 19** (not the 24th as our message said!). The last thing we want to do is create confusion around voting, so I apologize for that and promise to be especially careful from now on. We'll share more detailed voting information as we get closer, but to recap, **_Early Voting dates for our race begin on October 19 and run through October 30_**. And if you gave last night, THANK YOU! Your support gave this grassroots, people-powered team the boost we needed to keep Keith Self on the run.

clean_body: | | | | It starts tomorrow, Peter. Mail-in ballots in New York are sent beginning 46 days before elections. So our team is going over our budget with a fine tooth comb, looking for the most effective ways to spend our resources. It’s working so far. Political experts just upgraded us from Lean-R to Tossup — but this sustained negative ad spending is exactly the type of thing that could wipe out all of our progress. That’s why we’re coming to you. If everyone reading this email donated just $17 or $10, we would have the resources to mobilize every voter recieving a ballot tomorrow and push back against Lawler’s dark money. But the harsh truth is, not everyone gives. We know we ask a lot — and don’t expect you to donate every single time we reach out. | | | | Peter, **The Trump Administration is gutting the Endangered Species Act without ever passing a law.** On September 14th, the director of the Fish and Wildlife Service quietly distributed a memo to federal field offices that fundamentally upends half a century of wildlife protection. Under their new interpretation, killing an endangered species is no longer illegal as long as it is an "accident" during the course of economic activity. If a massive commercial shipping vessel runs over an endangered whale, or a logging company clear-cuts a forest and crushes the roosting bats inside it, the federal government says it doesn't count as a crime because the developers didn't _mean_ to do it. They are quite literally giving the extraction lobby a "Get Out of Jail Free" card to bulldoze over America's most imperiled wildlife. [**This is a five-alarm fire for our public lands and the wildlife that depends on them. Will you pitch in $25 today to our rapid-response war chest to help us drag this corrupt memo into the light?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/xvwatzDeY4Ke42hf7VIyjg~~/AAUS1hA~/Iix0gLmkvB5t6iNZb4eEXXS8AGmI0TNhQJt6j1Guu7LL5qR0EcqOl8gsm7_drldPKUWYZnl_FpfIN9yGQEY-OmJAuEADIuTVhOcZhzpKbyjNrxlc2M8dDh2zrGef3syvg07kCmjs87iVXoRv92tXT6c5HcHR9sPNsNKRqLgUUkpRueecUnJACHL7QLCGobkq3smgda90EJSyhqeF9hOEuKTE6J3IGD4zVMUaKCXl5z_OxLLJ4Xz6XNyuVO1eL-dn) For decades, industries knew that if their commercial activities foreseeably killed endangered wildlife, they would be held accountable. That accountability forced them to operate carefully. It forced them to protect habitats. Now, the administration is using a decades-old dissenting opinion from Antonin Scalia to unilaterally strip that accountability away. They want to absolve their billionaire corporate donors of any responsibility when their bulldozers, drills, and ships wipe out endangered species to pad their bottom lines. They did this through a quiet internal memo because they know it is politically radioactive. They are banking on the American public being too distracted to notice before the upcoming elections. **We are going to prove them wrong by making sure every single voter knows exactly which politicians allowed federal bureaucrats to legalize the slaughter of our national wildlife.** [**Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 today to help us fund the backlash and hold them accountable at the ballot box?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/xvwatzDeY4Ke42hf7VIyjg~~/AAUS1hA~/Iix0gLmkvB5t6iNZb4eEXXS8AGmI0TNhQJt6j1Guu7LL5qR0EcqOl8gsm7_drldPKUWYZnl_FpfIN9yGQEY-OmJAuEADIuTVhOcZhzpKbyjNrxlc2M8dDh2zrGef3syvg07kCmjs87iVXoRv92tXT6c5HcHR9sPNsNKRqLgUUkpRueecUnJACHL7QLCGobkq3smgda90EJSyhqeF9hOEuKTE6J3IGD4zVMUaKCXl5z_OxLLJ4Xz6XNyuVO1eL-dn) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/xvwatzDeY4Ke42hf7VIyjg~~/AAUS1hA~/Iix0gLmkvB5t6iNZb4eEXXS8AGmI0TNhQJt6j1Guu7LL5qR0EcqOl8gsm7_drldPKUWYZnl_FpfIN9yGQEY-OmJAuEADIuTVhOcZhzpKbyjNrxlc2M8dDh2zrGef3syvg07kCmjs87iVXoRv92tXT6c5HcHR9sPNsNKRqLgUUkpRueecUnJACHL7QLCGobkq3smgda90EJSyhqeF9hOEuKTE6J3IGD4zVMUaKCXl5z_OxLLJ4Xz6XNyuVO1eL-dn) ** They think they can quietly sell out America's wildlife to the highest bidder. clean_body: They just legalized killing endangered species They just legalized killing endangered species | | | | | Peter, The Trump Administration is gutting the Endangered Species Act without ever passing a law. On September 14th, the director of the Fish and Wildlife Service quietly distributed a memo to federal field offices that fundamentally upends half a century of wildlife protection. Under their new interpretation, killing an endangered species is no longer illegal as long as it is an "accident" during the course of economic activity. If a massive commercial shipping vessel runs over an endangered whale, or a logging company clear-cuts a forest and crushes the roosting bats inside it, the federal government says it doesn't count as a crime because the developers didn't mean to do it. They are quite literally giving the extraction lobby a "Get Out of Jail Free" card to bulldoze over America's most imperiled wildlife. For decades, industries knew that if their commercial activities foreseeably killed endangered wildlife, they would be held accountable. That accountability forced them to operate carefully. It forced them to protect habitats. Now, the administration is using a decades-old dissenting opinion from Antonin Scalia to unilaterally strip that accountability away. They want to absolve their billionaire corporate donors of any responsibility when their bulldozers, drills, and ships wipe out endangered species to pad their bottom lines. They did this through a quiet internal memo because they know it is politically radioactive. They are banking on the American public being too distracted to notice before the upcoming elections. We are going to prove them wrong by making sure every single voter knows exactly which politicians allowed federal bureaucrats to legalize the slaughter of our national wildlife. They think they can quietly sell out America's wildlife to the highest bidder. Let's make sure it costs them their jobs. You take our land—we take your seat. For the wild, Public Land Warriors | Public Land Warriors728 Gilbert StHelena, MT 59601United States "Website"

subject: BREAKING: We are leading this race
body:
A brand-new poll just showed something that's never happened before.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, look at this:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260917_2_sienapoll.nun8GS&refcode=em20260917-2143&amount=5&t=1&akid=2143%2E299639%2EVgaEuF)
In his four campaigns for governor, Greg Abbott has _never_ _once_ been shown trailing in a statewide Texas poll. _That changed today._
**A brand-new poll just showed us ahead of Abbott by four points,** while he's asking Texans for a fourth term. Not within range. Not closing the gap. Ahead. For the first time.
Here’s what’s happening: Texans are getting a clear look at what twelve years of Greg Abbott has actually cost them. Rising grocery bills. Rising property taxes. Data centers flooding the state while the people footing the bill get nothing back. And when they look at me, they’re seeing someone who’s spent her career fighting for Texas families — not just for the people at the top.
**None of this happens without you.** We are competitive in this race because of the 170,000 people who've chipped in to build this campaign. Our people-powered movement is working. We are clearly breaking through.
But Abbott has a firehose of money aimed at us — $67 million in the bank, and he's already outspent us 10-to-1. He's never had to run from behind before. With this poll out there, he's going to open that firehose all the way to drown out our campaign before Texans vote.
We can't match him dollar for dollar. But we can outnumber him — that's how we got here. You haven't joined the 170,000 donors who've built this campaign yet. We need you to become one today by joining this movement with your first gift right now.
**[Can you chip in $5 right now to help us keep building a campaign that can defeat Greg Abbott and take Texas back?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260917_2_sienapoll.nun8GS&refcode=em20260917-2143&amount=5&t=2&akid=2143%2E299639%2EVgaEuF)**

Greg Abbott has never polled behind in a race for governor. Not once. Now that he has, he's going to come at us with everything he's got. We need everything you've got, too.
Gratefully,
Gina

* * *
Yesterday, Congressman Thomas Massie, perhaps the last Republican in the entire party with any guts, did something that should be routine in a functioning democracy. He introduced a discharge petition to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
I don't particularly care for Thomas Massie's politics. But credit where it's due, because what happened next tells you everything you need to know about the state of our government.
Massie didn't give Republican leadership a heads-up. They panicked. Donald Trump ordered Speaker Mike Johnson to shut it down, and Johnson did exactly what he was told. He put the House in recess rather than let his own members debate and vote on removing Hegseth from office.
Think about what that means. Hegseth is so unpopular in Congress that the votes are likely there to remove him. And a month and a half before the election, Republican leadership would rather shut down an entire branch of government than force their members to go on record about one of the least-liked cabinet secretaries in American history.
Hegseth has been an absolute disaster. He is hilariously unqualified for the job. He has clearly broken the law several times. He's quietly plotting a presidential campaign while waging an illegal, catastrophic war in Iran that has gotten an incredible number of people killed and decimated the global economy.
I could write this entire piece about Pete Hegseth's incompetence. I thought about it. But I want to point the spotlight somewhere else for a minute. I want to talk about Mike Johnson.
Because right now, we don't have a Congress.
Mike Johnson has abdicated his responsibility to lead a coequal branch of our government. The House of Representatives works exclusively for Donald Trump. Trump installed Johnson as Speaker, and House Republicans are too afraid of the president to stand up to him. So nothing happens in Congress unless Donald Trump signs off on it. No bill gets debated. No bill moves forward. No action gets taken. Not without the president's permission.
That is not how this is supposed to work.
Our founders got a lot right and a lot wrong, but they understood one thing clearly: power has to be checked. They envisioned a government where Congress holds its own powers and exercises oversight over the executive branch, where the judiciary holds its own powers and responsibilities, and where no single person gets to run the whole show.
Donald Trump has spent the last ten years tearing that apart. He's dramatically expanded executive power with help from the Supreme Court justices he put on the bench. The Senate barely moves without his approval. The House barely moves without his approval. And now we've reached the point where a likely majority of the House wants to impeach a lawbreaking, incompetent defense secretary, and they can't even hold a vote, because the Speaker shut the whole thing down on Trump's orders.
This government doesn't function at any level.
* * *

If you value having an independent voice doing that work every day, like this post, share it with someone you know, and help us reach more people.](https://substack.com/redirect/dc3fc278-7893-4bb8-9d16-bcb33397ab16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
It's one thing for a president to install incompetent boobs like Hegseth throughout the government. And believe me, there isn't one Pete Hegseth. There are a million Pete Hegseths working in this government right now. God knows how many of them are at the FDA right now, supposedly inspecting our food, after this administration gutted the place. It's part of the reason you can't find some of your favorite items on the shelf right now. The recalls just keep coming.
The check on all of that is supposed to be Congress. The check is supposed to be the courts.
Now the only check left is YOU. The American people. This election.
And Donald Trump is coming after that too.
He's attacking mail-in voting. He's purging people from the voter rolls in Texas. He and his allies are running plot after nefarious plot to make it harder for you to cast a ballot. And he's formed an unholy alliance with tech billionaires like Elon Musk, who are spending hundreds of millions of dollars to lie to you about Democratic candidates like James Talarico, because they're terrified he's about to win the Texas Senate race and turn Texas blue for the first time in a very long time.
That's why winning these midterms, and winning them big, has to be our highest priority.
A big win doesn't just send a message about the abject failure of Trump's second term. It sends a message to the Republican Party that we will no longer tolerate them turning our entire government into a single unified machine for Donald Trump, his radical far-right agenda, and his corruption.
Democrats winning the House and Senate means real, meaningful accountability and oversight of the executive branch. It won't fix everything overnight. The economy isn't going to magically recover in the next couple of years. I don't know that we can end this war in Iran. But I do know we can build a real check on this administration.
We can investigate Hegseth. We can investigate what's going on with Kash Patel and FBI recruits allowed to engage in bestiality. We can dig into the crypto schemes, the Tate brothers, and so many of the other things that have vexed us for so long while nobody in Washington takes them seriously.
Handing the gavels back to the Democratic Party, as imperfect as it is, is how we start. Then we build a better party. We bring real accountability back to Washington. And when we win in 2028, we elect a Democratic president who gets to work quickly to make a dramatic, meaningful difference in people's lives.
Because at the end of the day, all the drama in Washington, whether it's Mike Johnson, Pete Hegseth, Barron Trump, or whatever comes next, only matters because of what it does to you. An incompetent, broken Washington that has become an all-boys club where everyone protects each other and nobody is held accountable for anything, right up to the Epstein files, is never going to work to make your life better.
That's what we have to fix. It starts in the next month and a half. And there's no clearer example of why than Donald Trump ordering his Speaker to shut down the entire House to protect Pete Hegseth.
I'm going to keep covering all of it, every day, right up to Election Day and beyond. If this work matters to you, please consider becoming a paid subscriber. Independent voices are how we fight back when the people in charge have stopped doing their jobs. We can't do it without you.
With urgency,
--Mike

| | | | Hi Friend,
**The House also passed two bills that crack down on fraud** yesterday, during the last day of this session. _Two more wins for the American people!_
The first is the PROOF Act, which will allow federal investigators to request and use information from state agencies to catch fraudsters.
The second is The National Fraud Enforcement Division Act, which will establish the National Fraud Enforcement Division within the Department of Justice to continue investigating and remedying fraud affecting federally funded programs.
Both bills passed with bipartisan support, yet **Suhas Subramanyam voted no on both**.
**If you think VA-10 deserves a Congressman who is dedicated to fighting fraud and reclaiming money meant for the American people, I'd be honored to have your support.**
---
| | [DONATE TO FIGHTING FRAUD](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
| | | The DOJ's fraud enforcement division has already _clawed back over $1 billion in its first year alone,_ money that was stolen from American taxpayers by people gaming programs meant to help people in need. Giving that division a permanent legal foundation and letting federal and state investigators share information to catch fraud faster isn't a partisan idea, **it's basic stewardship of every dollar we send to Washington.**
Stopping fraud and protecting taxpayer dollars shouldn't be a hard vote, Friend!

Cutting fraud is _one of the key ways to get our national budget under control_ without cutting the programs people actually depend on.
As a father, I want my kids and grandkids to inherit an economy full of opportunity, not a mountain of debt that includes money that should have gone to real people, but was stolen instead.
**_We owe it to the next generation to fix this now, not hand them the same fight._**

[SAVE NO TAX ON SOCIAL SECURITY](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=a6dd7c01703d4e4489e7ceedaef68080&_e=BkrzWrl0v_b4HDC6Z1-G9YWOWrzwU3Is22Z8-Dzv8QXJCCbjHS20pHnMgLR05X7vbzbLMNcm5FOu6S5XNbQRXhkYELyXU7TEKOTLY_6m7cquJ3uRMJ-oq770xa15HSaSXREPmC0QqwfrRVGMWisnouTa8QDkwQgch6Q250tnc2Ze9KT7UBfzVQX3UG8ccAlMQKTS_IY8D4Ldj21pJcNoqqyGCdmAYamKhM1C3lGM4XzgGR4t_TNGzbMHM4WjSuqkMv0yE45Owt2fzmT23E_v-3gP1sGQEpfwLzSyk5pn99yLOFCmt5g2kkzOuCAPXMrZJc_0G5NP-WYhlU9thv2JJj6l-Bp_soFB-QeS2I84_Tlop4VMrPyGiFRVXAmPXoBcBDWtQXPV4g_n6HCTXiFBJ-IXouo_oTq6zFFZ4JhQhI3sGIkYMEF7JWGYvAULueU1bVUUvt4cVDph0TBtiT8CBqS7VOgAR65-VCQjuo1vPUoEHMGPxMHhPP8wvT9jsINColkTtXsQR4WFXH2tKJGhkw%3D%3D)

body:
It’s Our Turn Now |
---

| | | | It’s Constitution Day, the anniversary of the day our founders completed signing the revolutionary document in 1787. How revolutionary it was. The new government was a new form of government, putting power not in a King but in the people. As President Lincoln later described it: a government “of the people, by the people, and for the people.” During the second Trump administration, our Constitution has been tested every single day and in every way imaginable. And it will continue to be. I have written to you often about those attacks on our Constitution. We see attacks on the rights and privileges our Constitution guarantees for citizens—from freedom of speech, press, assembly, and religion to freedom to travel to citizenship itself. We see attacks on the separation of powers and the role of the Congress and the courts—from failing to execute the laws the Congress has passed to rejecting the decisions of the courts. And, sadly, we have seen this Republican-led Congress help make it happen. But what we can also see now is that Election Day is almost here. The Constitution gives us the foundation for a government of, by, and for the people. But its principles have endured only because generation after generation of Americans have taken responsibility for defending them, and for making their promises real for more people. It’s our turn now. And we can do our part this year by voting for people who will defend our Constitution from all enemies. More than that, we can work to elect them. That’s what we are doing on TeamLizzie. Thank you for being a part of it. Together we can do anything,

What's up, everybody? Matt Diemer, the **Angry Democrat** here.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/429a6cd9-e507-4f55-bca3-ec10580df557?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, and Trump is the reason. The bill failed a Senate cloture vote, 49-50, with one senator not voting. It needed 60 votes to advance to the floor for debate, and it did not even come close.
The crypto industry was looking forward to this bill because it would have created rules of the road for cryptocurrency. It would have established which digital assets, tokens, commodities and securities fell under the authority of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and which fell under the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Instead, the bill did not move. For now, it is dead, and we need to talk about why.
* * *
## **What the CLARITY Act Was Supposed to Do**
The CLARITY Act was supposed to create clearer divisions between the SEC and CFTC.
If you remember what happened in 2017, 2018 and 2019, as well as throughout the Biden administration, Gary Gensler and the SEC fought with crypto companies over which agency had jurisdiction. The SEC was essentially regulating through enforcement actions.
Companies would argue that they fell under the CFTC for one reason or another, and the SEC would come in and say, "No, no, no. We are the ones who are supposed to regulate you."
We needed a clear division.
We needed more durable rules for exchanges, tokens, token issuers, decentralized finance, developers and American investment products. Companies need to know the rules before they build products, not after the SEC files a lawsuit against them.
Critics opposed the Senate draft for several reasons. Some lawmakers said the ethics provisions were too weak. That had everything to do with Trump and his crypto businesses, including World Liberty Financial, USD1, the Trump token and the Melania token.
Banks also objected to stablecoin reward structures because they were worried those rewards could pull deposits away from traditional banks.
If you hold a stablecoin instead of dollars in a bank, Coinbase, Kraken, Gemini or another company holding those tokens could pay you a yield. The banks looked at that and said, "Whoa, whoa, whoa. We cannot let people take their dollars, put them somewhere else and make money from them. We have to keep that money here."
They created all kinds of rules and excuses for why that was supposedly necessary.
Some lawmakers also wanted tougher anti-money-laundering rules, consumer protections and enforcement language.
* * *
## **The Vote**
The cloture vote failed, 49-50, with one senator not voting. The legislation needed 60 votes to advance to the floor for debate.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/28184632-818f-4593-af46-bf8365c63adb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Forty-nine Republicans voted yes. Forty-four Democrats and both independents voted no. Several Republicans also voted no, including Susan Collins, Josh Hawley, Jerry Moran and Thom Tillis.
Collins opposed advancing the bill and raised concerns about bank deposits and what she described as a moving target. Hawley raised similar concerns about stablecoin rewards and the possibility that deposits could move from traditional banks into stablecoins held through companies such as Coinbase and Kraken.
The argument was that banks might not have enough deposits available for lending, potentially creating a serious problem for community banks.
There was also concern that the legislation had changed too many times. Just days before the vote, Republicans said they had accepted 126 Democratic additions or changes, including provisions governing ethics within the cryptocurrency industry and restrictions involving the president, his family and their companies.
Questions about whether Trump should divest, use a blind trust or face restrictions involving his family's businesses were all part of the negotiations led by Republican Senator Thom Tillis and Democratic Senator Ruben Gallego.
Tillis voted no for procedural reasons so the bill could potentially be reconsidered later. Moran's reasoning was less public, so I am going to assume there were political calculations involved there as well.
Independents Angus King and Bernie Sanders both voted no. Chris Coons did not vote.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6580bba5-d297-4a4d-9742-2ef47b48ca3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
## **Trump Killed the CLARITY Act**
Why did the CLARITY Act fail?
The biggest reason was Trump.
Dennis Porter put it best:
> "Hot take: Trump coin, World Liberty, USD1 and Melania coin are why CLARITY failed."
> | [](https://substack.com/redirect/24337d1e-34de-4fff-876d-383a7bc27295?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
> ---|---|---
Trump and his family have reportedly made approximately **$1.3 billion from their cryptocurrency businesses.** That is more than all previous United States presidents made during their terms combined...

Trump's Corruption: Trump coin, World Liberty, USD1 and Melania coin are why CLARITY failed. | | | Sep 17| | | ∙| | Preview ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | What's up, everybody? Matt Diemer, the Angry Democrat here. | | ---|---|--- The Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, and Trump is the reason. The bill failed a Senate cloture vote, 49-50, with one senator not voting. It needed 60 votes to advance to the floor for debate, and it did not even come close. The crypto industry was looking forward to this bill because it would have created rules of the road for cryptocurrency. It would have established which digital assets, tokens, commodities and securities fell under the authority of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and which fell under the Securities and Exchange Commission. Instead, the bill did not move. For now, it is dead, and we need to talk about why. What the CLARITY Act Was Supposed to Do The CLARITY Act was supposed to create clearer divisions between the SEC and CFTC. If you remember what happened in 2017, 2018 and 2019, as well as throughout the Biden administration, Gary Gensler and the SEC fought with crypto companies over which agency had jurisdiction. The SEC was essentially regulating through enforcement actions. Companies would argue that they fell under the CFTC for one reason or another, and the SEC would come in and say, "No, no, no. We are the ones who are supposed to regulate you." We needed a clear division. We needed more durable rules for exchanges, tokens, token issuers, decentralized finance, developers and American investment products. Companies need to know the rules before they build products, not after the SEC files a lawsuit against them. Critics opposed the Senate draft for several reasons. Some lawmakers said the ethics provisions were too weak. That had everything to do with Trump and his crypto businesses, including World Liberty Financial, USD1, the Trump token and the Melania token. Banks also objected to stablecoin reward structures because they were worried those rewards could pull deposits away from traditional banks. If you hold a stablecoin instead of dollars in a bank, Coinbase, Kraken, Gemini or another company holding those tokens could pay you a yield. The banks looked at that and said, "Whoa, whoa, whoa. We cannot let people take their dollars, put them somewhere else and make money from them. We have to keep that money here." They created all kinds of rules and excuses for why that was supposedly necessary. Some lawmakers also wanted tougher anti-money-laundering rules, consumer protections and enforcement language. The Vote The cloture vote failed, 49-50, with one senator not voting. The legislation needed 60 votes to advance to the floor for debate. | | ---|---|--- Forty-nine Republicans voted yes. Forty-four Democrats and both independents voted no. Several Republicans also voted no, including Susan Collins, Josh Hawley, Jerry Moran and Thom Tillis. Collins opposed advancing the bill and raised concerns about bank deposits and what she described as a moving target. Hawley raised similar concerns about stablecoin rewards and the possibility that deposits could move from traditional banks into stablecoins held through companies such as Coinbase and Kraken. The argument was that banks might not have enough deposits available for lending, potentially creating a serious problem for community banks. There was also concern that the legislation had changed too many times. Just days before the vote, Republicans said they had accepted 126 Democratic additions or changes, including provisions governing ethics within the cryptocurrency industry and restrictions involving the president, his family and their companies. Questions about whether Trump should divest, use a blind trust or face restrictions involving his family's businesses were all part of the negotiations led by Republican Senator Thom Tillis and Democratic Senator Ruben Gallego. Tillis voted no for procedural reasons so the bill could potentially be reconsidered later. Moran's reasoning was less public, so I am going to assume there were political calculations involved there as well. Independents Angus King and Bernie Sanders both voted no. Chris Coons did not vote. | | ---|---|--- Trump Killed the CLARITY Act Why did the CLARITY Act fail? The biggest reason was Trump. Dennis Porter put it best: "Hot take: Trump coin, World Liberty, USD1 and Melania coin are why CLARITY failed." | | ---|---|--- Trump and his family have reportedly made approximately $1.3 billion from their cryptocurrency businesses. I was born and raised here in Maryland, near the steelmill at Sparrows Point in eastern Baltimore County. I witnessed firsthand the devastation the mill's closure had on my friends and family. People didn’t just lose their jobs – they lost hope.
So I knew early on that I wanted to do whatever I could to help bring back hope through opportunity.
As a senior at Sparrows Point High School, I was appointed as a student member to the Baltimore County Board of Education. Debating how to invest millions of tax dollars as a 17-year-old wasn’t easy, but it made me excited about education policy.
A math teacher and mentor, Debbie Thomas, suggested I consider Goucher College after graduation. She believed Goucher would give me the support and community I needed to take a step no one else in my family had taken before — she was right, and that encouragement meant more to me than she probably ever realized. Just like in high school, I dipped my toes into public service. In my junior year at Goucher, I was elected to a term on the Maryland Democratic State Central Committee.
After college, I stuck with my passion for education and became a social studies and special education teacher at Patapsco High School. I also worked as a county-wide resource teacher.
I loved teaching. But seeing the challenges facing students, their families, the staff — it made me want to serve more in a bigger way.
When I was appointed to fill a vacant Maryland House of Delegates seat, to me, it felt like a chance to take what I was doing in the classroom to scale. Instead of touching the lives of 30 kids every year, there were 300,000 Maryland kids I could fight for.
It's still humbling — and honestly a little wild — to know that a kid from Dundalk is now part of the group responsible for leading our nation. But I’ve taken my small town roots to Washington and am committed to fighting for families like my own. It's why I’m working so hard to lower costs and end the rampant corruption.
You shouldn’t have to outbid a billionaire just to get your Congressman to listen to you. A parent working two jobs, a teacher trying to make ends meet, or a small-business owner just trying to keep the lights on should have just as much say in our government as the wealthiest special interest in Washington.
That’s the country I believe in. And it’s the kind of government I’m going to keep fighting for.
But I also know I can’t do it alone. If we’re going to take on big money and special interests that have too much power in Washington, we need a grassroots movement strong enough to stand up to them.
[**So if you believe, like I do, that our democracy should work for regular people — not billionaires, lobbyists, or special interests — will you chip in $5, $25, or whatever you can today to help me keep fighting for Maryland and for a government that answers to the people?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139400468/647232478/1153820233?refcode=email_091726_fightingfor&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDcvMS8xMDU4MjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDZjMDI1M2YtYjViMi1mMTExLWE2YTctMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uCH7_f4L9lT6J0AAMcPWH8ZgyUDfzTGkU8N4LDhzB_8=)

| | It has been more than a year since President Trump implemented the Big Ugly Law. President Trump promised to lower costs, but the Big Ugly Law has increased costs:
* Taking health care away from more than 328,000 Washingtonians.
* Stripping 129,000 Washingtonians of their SNAP benefits.
* Putting 57,000 Washingtonians at risk of losing some or all access to food assistance.
* Giving the top 0.1% of income earners a tax break of $846 per day.
* Giving people earning less than $50,000/year a tax break of 68¢ per day.

**I voted NO on the Big Ugly Law last year, and since then, every effort to reverse the damage has been blocked by the Republican Rip-Off.** Over the past year, I have heard from people all across Northwest Washington about how the Big Ugly Law has directly impacted them. It is my job to listen to your perspectives and experiences and lead legislation and advocacy in Washington, D.C., that improve our communities here at home. The Big Ugly Law promised deficit reduction, but that was not true. It was about gutting vital services and programs to pay for tax cuts for the richest Americans and the largest corporations. Costs are rising. People want solutions. I am working hard to take back the House in November so that we can put a stop to the Republican Rip-Off. body:
| __ |

**Lea el boletín en español abajo**

**We won a fully funded MAC program in Bexar County** ** ** **WE WON! 👏🏾** When Bexar County proposed budget cuts to public defense a few weeks back, TOP members and partners showed up, packed Commissioners Court, and demanded full funding for the Managed Assigned Counsel (MAC) program. On Tuesday, County Commissioners listened to the community and officially approved a budget that keeps MAC funding intact! Quality legal defense shouldn’t depend on how much money you have in your bank account. **This victory belongs to every community member who spoke up, organized, and fought to protect this essential program.** [_**Share our Facebook graphic here.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139401387/647234964/1552713664?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzBjN2EyYi1iN2IyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mPWDUrns4HGPdMjIZCO8NkafZRhpb9F66HqVmJy9bnk=&emci=a1883168-12b2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=170c7a2b-b7b2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=227997)
**Hosting our first-ever expungement clinic in Dallas** **TOP held its first-ever Dallas expungement clinic this past Saturday, Sept.12, at the Martin Luther King, Jr. Community Center, with nearly 250 people in attendance!** A total of __**87 eligible participants**__ were seen by legal professionals during the clinic, giving many attendees peace of mind knowing they will have old charges removed from their criminal record. TOP allies Texas Civil Rights Project (TCRP), ACLU of Texas, and CN Initiative provided helpful resources during the clinic, with Easy Expunctions conducting direct assessments with attendees who qualified to have their records cleared. This clinic was about more than clearing records, it was about clearing barriers. Our contributions to the United States – cultural, economic, political, and more – are vast and span centuries. We care about our families, our communities, and our collective future. While certain politicians try to divide us, pit us against other communities, and strip us of our rights, we Latinos continue to organize for a better tomorrow rooted in justice, humanity, and shared prosperity. Our voices will be heard and our movement will not be stopped.” **Julio McCall, a TOP member in Houston,** added: “At TOP, we understand our fates as Latinos are linked with those of our Black brothers and sisters. As an Afro-Latino who has for years called this country home, I know this connection full well, as it is my lived experience. This is the power of solidarity and how vital it is to our shared strength, especially at a time when Latino, Afro-Latino, and Black communities are being targeted by government budget cuts and regressive policies that seek to diminish us. That’s why no matter what country we’re from, the color of our skin, or the language we speak, we always have been – and always will be – stronger together. And through working together and learning from one another, there is nothing out of our reach.”

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: 9/11, In District, and Marion County Florida
body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12935790?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | | | |
---
| |
### NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,

**Thank you again for reelecting me as your Representative.** Since the election, I have been moving nonstop, and I want to share with you some of the things I have done.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://us.list-manage.com/14zlwyjuEfq?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=sXVjSq5qYP5k8rhNDWkKxaP9BhHC1sy72DdV4W3SYOJX8xP-b_MsQIqGBtM=) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.

---
| |
### Remembering 9/11
---
|
---
| | 25 years later, we stand together as Americans, remembering the lives and families forever changed that day.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | Friday was a special day... The Morning Started out in Ocala at the 9/11 Remembrance Ceremony. I then was honored to speak with our first responders at the Belleview Freedom Walk as we gathered to remember and honor the lives lost.
---
| |
### In the District
---
|
---
| | Joined **Marion Senior Services in Welcoming Lt. Gov. Collins to Ocala.** Marion Senior services spoke to him about their Senior Crisis Mobile Response Team. Then the Lt. Gov. spoke about his Operation Senior Shield.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Met with the team at **Heart of Florida Health Center** to learn more about the vital work they do throughout Marion County.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Stopped by the **Boys & Girls Clubs’ annual luncheon** to hear an update on the incredible work they’ve continued to do across Marion County.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | Had a great conversation over coffee with Realtors® about **the importance of eliminating property taxes in Florida.**
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | Attended the**United Way of Marion County’s 65th Anniversary Annual Luncheon** and helped celebrate **65 years of serving our community.** And a huge congrats to our **County Clerk, Greg Harrell,** for receiving the **Bonnie Heath Legacy Award.**
---
|
---
|
---
| | Honored to have joined **Attorney General James Uthmeier** for an important press conference on the investigation into **Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs)** and efforts to **lower prescription drug costs.**
---
|
---
|
---
| | Great to meet with **Isaiah House 117-Marion County** for the first time and learn about the incredible work they’re doing to support children in foster care. For more information, check out their website.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Enjoyed meeting with **Ellie Trueman, Bonnie Heath, and Katie Glynn of the Ocala Horse Alliance Foundation** to learn more about **The Black Stallion Reading Project** and how successful it has been for the past 7 years.
---
|
---
|
---
| | I appreciated meeting **Pastor De Jesus** to learn about **God Belongs in My City** and its **IronPath initiative.**
---
|
---
|
---
| | Stopped by **Zero Suicide Marion** and had the pleasure of speaking and learning more about the critical work they’re doing across our community to prevent suicide and save lives.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Had the opportunity to meet up with **Florida’s next Lieutenant Governor, Bryan Avila,** to discuss the future of Marion County and how we can continue supporting the Horse Capital of the World.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Enjoyed attending the **ROCKS Annual Fundraising event** and helping them celebrate 10 years!
---
|
---
| | Thank you for your feedback and for being interested in our state government. These are important issues affecting everyone, and I need **your** help to make progress for our constituents. I look forward to sharing with you again soon.
Best regards,
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Ryan Chamberlin****State Representative****District 24**
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | [](https://us.list-manage.com/wz1zLfX737o?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=EoLAA5wXL8A1amopdoz_pfjN7pRE_SzWW5yqNeVOVJa6wqXG5k1YLWQexCY=)
---
[](https://us.list-manage.com/MCDxFzzbvv5?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=rRP9mlgl3wH5NkmFnBH_KZxdQAWdnaWhfceG8omX0lseKZEBEnIf37wbcEg=)
---

body:
Abdul El-Sayed is the courageous fighter Michigan deserves.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260917-1&t=1&akid=4026%2E587540%2EdENs-q)
Exciting news, Peter:
**Leaders We Deserve is proud to announce we’re endorsing Abdul El-Sayed for U.S. Senate in Michigan!**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260917_1_abdul.1M3fsZ&refcode=em20260917-4026&amount=5&t=2&akid=4026%2E587540%2EdENs-q)
I’ll tell you more, but first, Abdul just won the most expensive Democratic Senate primary in Michigan’s history without taking a single dollar from corporate PACs. **Now he’s taking on Trump’s hand-picked candidate Mike Rogers to win Michigan’s Senate seat — and he needs your support to get there.** **[Will you split a $5 contribution between Abdul El-Sayed and Leaders We Deserve today?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260917_1_abdul.1M3fsZ&refcode=em20260917-4026&amount=5&t=3&akid=4026%2E587540%2EdENs-q)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260917_1_abdul.1M3fsZ&amount=5&refcode=em20260917-4026&t=4&akid=4026%2E587540%2EdENs-q)**
**Abdul El-Sayed** is a doctor, epidemiologist, and the son of an Egyptian immigrant born and raised in Michigan. He grew up attending Michigan public schools and went on to become a Rhodes Scholar earning dual doctorates from Oxford and Columbia before coming home to serve the community that raised him.
He put that training to work rebuilding Detroit’s Health Department after the city’s bankruptcy left it gutted, then ran Wayne County’s health department serving over 1.8 million residents. He got free glasses for kids who couldn’t afford them, ripped lead out of Detroit schools in the wake of the Flint water crisis, led an initiative to launch 100 free public health vending machines across his county to dispense life-saving Narcan to curb opioid overdoses, launched an initiative for air quality monitors to hold Marathon Petroleum accountable in Michigan’s most polluted zipcode, and led a program working to cancel up to $700 million in medical debt for 300,000 Michiganders.
In Congress, Abdul will fight to pass Medicare for All and cancel medical debt nationwide, carrying on the same fight he’s already led at the local level. He’ll push to get corporate money out of politics for good, champion a national renters’ bill of rights so tenants know exactly what protections they’re entitled to, and go after the hedge funds and corporate landlords buying up housing stock and driving rent through the roof. He’ll also fight to pass the PRO act and defend every worker’s right to organize, bargain collectively, and be treated with dignity.
Listen, Peter: AIPAC, Big Pharma, the NRA and every other corporate interest used to buying whatever they want in Washington would love nothing more than to see Abdul lose this race. Outside groups poured over _$70 million_ into defeating him in the primary alone.
**That’s because they know Abdul won’t do their bidding — the only people he’ll answer to are Michiganders.**
His opponent, Republican Mike Rogers, is Trump’s hand-picked candidate, running to protect the same broken system that’s failed working families for years. He took over $1 million from Big Pharma as a Congressman, voted against letting Medicare negotiate lower drug prices, and supported huge cuts to SNAP benefits putting hundreds of thousands of Michiganders who rely on social safety nets to survive at risk.
Abdul is different — and he can win this. **His recent primary victory is proof that people-powered politics can beat corporate money, even in the most expensive Senate primary Michigan has ever seen. He just needs your support to get over the finish line.**
That’s where you come in. Leaders We Deserve doesn’t take a single dollar from corporate PACs or special interests. Neither does Abdul. Our ability to back candidates like him depends entirely on supporters like you showing up when it counts.
**[So Peter, will you split a $5 contribution between Abdul and Leaders We Deserve today to help send a real fighter to the Senate?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260917_1_abdul.1M3fsZ&refcode=em20260917-4026&amount=5&t=5&akid=4026%2E587540%2EdENs-q)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260917_1_abdul.1M3fsZ&amount=5&refcode=em20260917-4026&t=24&akid=4026%2E587540%2EdENs-q)**
Thank you,
David Hogg

Fellow Concerned American,

Parents send their kids to school to learn reading, writing, and math... not to receive anatomically explicit toys with removable body parts from school staff.

But that’s exactly what might be coming to Minnesota schools soon.

**Fox News reported that “MyGender Dolls” will be available to school counselors, educators, and clinicians this school year.**

These “trans” dolls were developed through the University of Minnesota’s Early Innovation Fund, under a program Gov. Tim Walz has championed and been personally honored for. _They ship with removable, swappable genitalia and are built for children**ages 4-10**_.

And it gets worse...

Not a single Minnesota parent that Defending Education spoke with had received any notification about the dolls. **_There is no confirmed way to opt out_**.

That’s why Defending Education filed a federal privacy complaint – citing violations of the Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment, and the First and Fourteenth Amendments.

I’m Nicole Neily, President of **Defending Education** – a national grassroots organization fighting to restore academic excellence and parental rights in America’s schools.

We believe four-year-olds have no business handling anatomically explicit material from any adult, in any building, for any reason. **We believe parents – not a governor, not a university lab – decide what’s appropriate for their child.**

And we believe it’s time to ask Americans plainly where they stand.

Please take our one-question poll right now:
**📊 NATIONAL DEFENDING EDUCATION POLL 📊** [**[POLL] Should anatomically explicit “trans” gender dolls be given to 4- to 10-year-olds in schools?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDJ9AAwAAAAAAwOih5XReQdpWV7pMn7vf1Ehy6aMTX8H4jS__70-wXr_2Kf-xotCG6mWIVF1x40ZbVJyajKOphMK7QqcJ_A1RHWIKCLG4WkogVX3TY15mg)

The Regime Open — September 17, 2026
The Fed Said 'Stay in Our Lane.' Trump Just Told Saudi Arabia the Same Thing.
A unanimous hike, a chair publicly asserting independence, and a White House declining to expand the war for an ally under attack — two institutions drew boundaries on the same day.
|
---
Wednesday delivered the decision this newsletter had counted down to for a week — and then, within hours, a second and arguably more consequential decision landed quietly beside it. **Verified fact:** the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate by a quarter point to 3.75%–4.00% in a unanimous 12-0 vote, its first hike since 2023, with the median official's projection pointing to at least one more increase before year-end. The Dow fell roughly 1.2% (about 600 points), the S&P; 500 fell 0.4%, and the Nasdaq was little changed. Separately, President Trump rejected a request from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman for direct U.S. military action against the Houthis, even as Saudi Arabia vowed “firm” retaliation for the attempted Mecca drone strike.
| | Regime Signal 01 — A Hike Everyone Expected Still Moved the Market
---|---
**Our interpretation:** an 85%-priced-in hike should not, on its own, move indexes by a full percentage point. The Dow's roughly 600-point drop suggests markets were reacting less to the decision itself than to the dot plot's signal of at least one further hike this year — confirmation that Wednesday was the start of a cycle, not a single contained response to the energy shock. **What remains unknown** is whether that one additional hike is itself contingent on oil prices staying elevated, or whether the Fed now sees inflation as broader than the war alone.
| | Regime Signal 02 — Warsh Answered the Independence Question Directly
---|---
**Verified fact:** in his press conference, Chair Kevin Warsh said, “We stay in our lane. We'll let people that do trade policy and fiscal policy stay in their lane too,” declining to comment on President Trump's public pressure campaign for lower rates. **Our interpretation:** after two weeks of escalating administration pressure — culminating in a trade-suspension threat tied explicitly to the rate decision — a unanimous vote and a chair publicly drawing a boundary around his institution's independence is as close to a direct answer as this newsletter expected to see this week.
| | Regime Signal 03 — Washington Drew a Different Boundary Overnight
---|---
**Verified fact:** President Trump declined Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's request for direct U.S. military intervention against the Houthis, even as Saudi Arabia pledged firm retaliation for the attempted Mecca strike and continued its own air campaign. **Our interpretation:** two very different institutions — the Fed and the White House — each drew a boundary this week around how far they will go in response to pressure from an ally or a political constituency. Whether that is coincidence or a broader posture of restraint is worth watching across both the monetary and military tracks in the days ahead.
| | Today’s Confirmation Point
---|---
Watch Saudi Arabia's actual retaliatory response to the Mecca incident in the next 24–48 hours, now that it must act without a U.S. military commitment behind it — and watch whether Wednesday's post-hike selloff extends into Thursday's session or stabilizes now that the decision itself is behind the market.

We need courageous champions in office who understand that clean air, clean water, a stable climate, and a functioning democracy are not luxuries. They are things the government is supposed to protect.

Expected to Erase Limits on Climate Pollution From Power Plants – The New York Times The Trump Administration is preparing to erase limits on climate pollution from coal- and gas-fired power plants — yet another gift to the fossil fuel industry at the expense of our health and our future. In the statement from the EPA itself, this rule change will “save” the power plant industry over $300 billion in costs. And the price we pay? Well, it’s measured in more asthma, more pollution, and more power for the very industries that created this crisis in the first place. Enough is enough. Trump and his polluting buddies are telling us exactly whose side they’re on. And it isn’t ours. We should believe them – and fight like hell for leaders who will never put profit over people. We need courageous champions in office who understand that clean air, clean water, a stable climate, and a functioning democracy are not luxuries. They are things the government is supposed to protect. That’s exactly why I created the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. # Trump wanted 1%. His Fed chief just hiked to 4%.
The Federal Reserve **[voted 12-0 Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/cf11416f-2a00-42ad-a18e-f44d5d5516c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to raise its benchmark rate a quarter point to[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/af41f055-6913-472e-b497-2fa3fd8eb439?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[3.75%-4%,](https://substack.com/redirect/af41f055-6913-472e-b497-2fa3fd8eb439?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the first hike **[since July 2023,](https://substack.com/redirect/bf9373ee-37e1-452f-a023-2b622d493ddf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and most officials still see another increase this year.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6f6be60e-9430-4981-899d-4c95f74060a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Dots still point higher:** Sixteen of 18 participants **[expect another 2026 hike,](https://substack.com/redirect/52b8629b-7fca-4968-9aae-b1c380c955b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/52b8629b-7fca-4968-9aae-b1c380c955b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and four of those see two more. Chair Kevin Warsh again submitted no dot. **[The median path holds in 2027.](https://substack.com/redirect/240c5e0d-ccf1-4240-8c69-62b8a41234b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Warsh calls policy easy:** Inflation has been **["too high ... for too long,"](https://substack.com/redirect/02330bdc-01c9-41f3-8502-57f9fa7adb47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** he said, and he would be "hard-pressed to describe broad financial conditions as restrictive."
* **Forecasts moved up:** Officials lifted 2026 PCE inflation to 3.7% and core to 3.4%, both 0.1 point above June. They do not see the 2% target until 2029. Unemployment is projected at 4.1%.
* **Trump wants 1%:** Hours later Trump wrote that U.S. rates **["should be 1%, or less."](https://substack.com/redirect/02c2c5ab-0a75-4e4c-8d78-5e2e50196409?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** He said he still relies on Warsh, **[told him before the vote he"might as well vote with the board,"](https://substack.com/redirect/79611a79-e9ea-42f8-a8ad-d3b326c8e0ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and wants him "independent."

# West Texas Intermediate oil flirts with $100 after Saudis open an Oman workaround
Brent crude **[fell 2.6% to $103.05 Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/28b9325f-2c57-4d54-a7de-ca2812b6fc48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Saudi Arabia offered extra Asian cargoes through ship-to-ship transfers near Oman's Sohar, easing fears a damaged pipeline would choke exports.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c106bcea-eb84-4add-be66-3b154fd8c7e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Shuttle workaround used:** Vessels carry crude through the Strait of Hormuz and load tankers waiting outside, so those ships can avoid sailing into the Gulf under Iranian-attack risk.
* **Transfer volumes jumped:** Ship-to-ship moves in the Gulf of Oman rose to 2.7 million barrels a day from 1.5 million in August, Kpler's Matt Smith said.[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/877fec52-41a4-4eba-9dd1-b8e6c904f810?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[WTI last traded at $100.55, down 1.8%.](https://substack.com/redirect/877fec52-41a4-4eba-9dd1-b8e6c904f810?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Repair clocks clash:** Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the Saudis took "quick action" with U.S. military help and called the East-West outage a brief interruption measured in days.
* **Disruption risk lingers:** Rapidan still sees Saudi exports down 400,000 barrels a day this month and said risk stays skewed toward a larger hit if the outage lasts past September **[or Iran, the Houthis, or proxies escalate.](https://substack.com/redirect/b20dc1d4-5b26-44f1-a054-b79739eddca3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# Bank of England holds rates at 3.75% and kills long-dated gilt sales
The Bank of England held its key rate at 3.75% in a 6-3 vote Thursday, **[diverging from the Federal Reserve,](https://substack.com/redirect/bcd946e7-0e3c-40f8-a018-2cb26c2c280b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/bcd946e7-0e3c-40f8-a018-2cb26c2c280b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and paused gilt auctions while rewriting its tightening plan.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41ea9145-a69d-4508-b81f-4fc69c97e908?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Three dissenters hiked:** Huw Pill, Megan Greene, and Catherine Mann voted to raise rates. Officials saw little second-round wage and price pressure so far but said those risks have grown.
* **Portfolio runoff mapped:** The Bank will unwind a £488 billion ($650 billion) gilt stock by 2034 and keep £120 billion of 2049-or-later bonds against future banknote issuance.
* **Sales go quiet:** The remaining £146 billion of 2035-2049 gilts would be sold at £20 billion a year, possibly to the Debt Management Office. All planned QT auctions pause until April.
* **Losses already booked:** Quantitative tightening has cost taxpayers £110 billion since 2022. Governor Andrew Bailey told Chancellor John Healey the overhaul "preserves the independence of monetary policy." **[Gilt yields fell about 10 basis points.](https://substack.com/redirect/410a57d9-7710-4cd9-90f0-1540562b5dce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# Stocks rebound as the 10-year slips back under 5%
U.S. **[stocks climbed Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/769fa5e8-554b-4802-a4a0-3d69b8045e60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the Federal Reserve's first rate increase in three years, as Treasury yields and oil prices eased and investors treated the hike as inflation insurance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8772f150-0065-4e5d-9f4d-a67adafb8527?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Indexes bounce early:** The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite jumped about 1% and 1.4% at the open. The Dow traded at 51,758.11, up 296.21, or 0.58%.
* **Yields slip back:** The 10-year Treasury yield fell 5 basis points to about 4.94%. Brent crude **[changed hands near $102 a barrel](https://substack.com/redirect/a35cd627-6a56-403f-9816-43efadd7d1f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/a35cd627-6a56-403f-9816-43efadd7d1f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and West Texas Intermediate **[traded near $100.](https://substack.com/redirect/15169686-48c6-41a0-b28e-aa9918fdeff9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Chip stocks lead:** Nvidia rose more than 2%, and the other Magnificent Seven names were higher in premarket trade. Bitcoin gained about 1% to hold above $76,000; gold stayed above $4,400.
* **Independence read mixed:** Manulife's Matthew Miskin said the meeting "does make them look independent" and "adds trust to the market," but warned the Fed **["may have come off a little too hawkish."](https://substack.com/redirect/240c5e0d-ccf1-4240-8c69-62b8a41234b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# Jobless claims plunge to 196k the morning after Warsh's hike, lowest since mid-July
Weekly U.S. applications for unemployment benefits[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/0165cb47-5b2c-497f-b2aa-05c5bba7d28e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[fell to 196,000 last week, t](https://substack.com/redirect/0165cb47-5b2c-497f-b2aa-05c5bba7d28e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** he fewest since mid-July and well below forecasts, another sign layoffs remain scarce.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/764841bd-c1b6-46d7-bd10-35bc7239ba04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Claims beat forecasts:** Applications dropped from 206,000 the week before. Economists had expected 207,500, FactSet said. The four-week average slid to 203,250.
* **Layoffs stay rare:** Claims have mostly held in a 200,000-to-230,000 range for the past year. Businesses remain reluctant to cut staff after the labor shortages that followed pandemic lockdowns.
* **Hiring stays modest:** Employers added an average 80,000 jobs a month this year, including 162,000 in August, below the 166,000 monthly average in 2023 and 2024.
* **Unadjusted series historic:** On an unadjusted basis, **[last week's initial claims were the lowest since 1969.](https://substack.com/redirect/04816de1-5df6-4c43-b72f-7992c406a7ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/04816de1-5df6-4c43-b72f-7992c406a7ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Continuing claims fell to the lowest level since January 2024.

# Housing just split in two. Houses up +7.6%. Apartments down −22.5%.
U.S.[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/2245a7c6-de77-44a2-8da5-412569d0db58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[single-family housing starts jumped 7.6% in August,](https://substack.com/redirect/2245a7c6-de77-44a2-8da5-412569d0db58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** but overall construction fell 2.6% as apartment work and permits dropped and mortgage rates hit a more than 1-year high.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a446236e-f1e0-44b1-aae7-8e15c087f71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Census print mixed:** Single-family starts **[rose to a 918,000 annual rate,](https://substack.com/redirect/28924c12-130f-4521-a73f-4b8ea039a0a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/28924c12-130f-4521-a73f-4b8ea039a0a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)up 5.2% from a year earlier. Permits for those homes fell 1.8% to 878,000 units.
* **Apartments dragged totals:** Starts on buildings with 5 or more units plunged 22.5% to 344,000. Overall starts ran at 1.275 million, down 1.2%; total permits fell 2.7% to 1.394 million.
* **Mortgage rates climbed:** The average 30-year fixed rate was 6.76% last week, Freddie Mac said, the highest in more than a year and up from 6.71% the week before.
* **Builder mood sank:** Single-family builder sentiment fell to a 1-year low in September, the NAHB said Wednesday, blaming higher rates, labor shortages from an immigration crackdown, and tariff-driven material prices.

body:
We have entered the most critical stretch of this campaign—and your $50 contribution can help us reach voters across IL-11.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeffwalterforcongress/help-jeff-get-his-message-to-the-voters?e=fa724b03ca)
---

| | | | | |

Friends,
We are entering the most important stretch of this campaign, and I’m asking for your help.
**Our goal is to raise**[**$300,000**](https://us.list-manage.com/1B3iU00K7RW?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)**over the next 30 days.**
It’s ambitious, but we have a plan to get there: **I am asking everyone who receives this email, our friends, family members, and strongest supporters to each give my campaign**[**$50**](https://us.list-manage.com/T1fJNC6c5gy?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)**or raise**[**$50**](https://us.list-manage.com/bdDnh12Pb_S?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)**from their friends and families.**
That can mean contributing [$10](https://us.list-manage.com/AgzfB9et0iL?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20) a week over the next 5 weeks, [$25](https://us.list-manage.com/7nDgnrkNZ3y?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20) a week for the next 2 weeks, or [$50](https://us.list-manage.com/19MH34qiR9P?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20) today.
Why [$300,000](https://us.list-manage.com/NE0WdwTHV22?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)?
Because we need the resources to communicate directly with voters across the 11th District about the choice they will make this November.
**We want voters to know Bill Foster’s record.**
We want to tell them about Foster’s votes against election integrity and voter identification. We want voters to know that he voted against a simple resolution condemning socialism and the Democratic Socialists of America. We want voters to know that Bill voted against keeping men out of women’s sports.

We also want to ask the questions voters deserve answers to:
**Why won’t Bill Foster debate Jeff Walter?**
**Why do constituents tell us they struggle to get answers from their Congressman?**
**And after years in Washington, what has Bill Foster actually delivered for the people of the 11th District?**
Jeff Walter is ready to debate these issues, answer the tough questions, and take his case directly to the voters.
But getting that message to hundreds of thousands of voters costs money.Your support will help us:
* Send **8 campaign mailers** directly to voters across the district
* Expand and target Jeff’s message through **Text Message, YouTube and Facebook advertising**
* Increase our **streaming and digital advertising**
* Purchase the remaining **50 large campaign signs** we need across the district
* Put Bill Foster’s record directly in front of voters before they cast their ballots

[**If everyone receiving this email gives $50 or more, we can make enormous progress toward our $300,000 goal.**](https://us.list-manage.com/11S4Vcwq0CW?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)
This campaign has always been a team effort, and now we need our team to step up in a major way.
**Will you contribute**[**$50**](https://us.list-manage.com/RVWOdTNeH3B?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)**today and help us make sure voters hear Jeff’s message and see Bill Foster’s record before Election Day?**
Every dollar helps us reach another voter.
Thank you for standing with Jeff and Team Walter.
**Let’s raise**[**$300,000**](https://us.list-manage.com/sB0gDF2Rl1u?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)**. Let’s reach the voters. And let’s make sure the 11th District hears the facts.**
Jeff Walter
Candidate for Congress
Illinois’s 11th Congressional District

We want to tell them about Foster’s votes against election integrity and voter identification. We want voters to know that he voted against a simple resolution condemning socialism and the Democratic Socialists of America. We want voters to know that Bill voted against keeping men out of women’s sports. We also want to ask the questions voters deserve answers to: Why won’t Bill Foster debate Jeff Walter? Why do constituents tell us they struggle to get answers from their Congressman? And after years in Washington, what has Bill Foster actually delivered for the people of the 11th District? Jeff Walter is ready to debate these issues, answer the tough questions, and take his case directly to the voters. But getting that message to hundreds of thousands of voters costs money.Your support will help us: Send 8 campaign mailers directly to voters across the district Expand and target Jeff’s message through Text Message, YouTube and Facebook advertising Increase our streaming and digital advertising Purchase the remaining 50 large campaign signs we need across the district Put Bill Foster’s record directly in front of voters before they cast their ballots This campaign has always been a team effort, and now we need our team to step up in a major way. Will you contribute and help us make sure voters hear Jeff’s message and see Bill Foster’s record before Election Day? Every dollar helps us reach another voter. Thank you for standing with Jeff and Team Walter. Let’s raise. Let’s reach the voters. And let’s make sure the 11th District hears the facts.** Jeff Walter Candidate for Congress Illinois’s 11th Congressional District | | | | | | | mailto:info@jeffwaltforcongress.com | | | | | | | | | | == == "Share" == == "Share" "Share" == == "Share" | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Jeff Walter for Congress. It’s disgusting.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=2735eb9fbe6e4f3599be36498dbf2b66&_e=z87n6SgFjKZAvm0I4my0PodE2UldUpDYRuujw2BVzs-BZG1b5nrX_vYi-PAHz2Ga1Li22CPw1N1kHcavAmjLkPQ9OU7POB2xooM-XF5BrkqyHGIdtUHOlNZz0jKCmH4FBtENueQpHn7BuNur0Q0JEuGSQ14Qgb112wGCSQAlDn85jNC-MOZdsqoItRMjbRSIuFQAZnYBPjhGO7brAWQcSYUOgWef62eaGj18HyJZpu1BY1T8sAMg2TXvQBo1yLSJDJ4LxOVBlacWFh3BRrM-MOZSn3ph9UPysAz-uv4Wcps1Gv9lwsHz8dEnVsQ_SS6A9cfPLFY7en89MbwKnAQgML34UlO9kNjgI6PtR_CkSpPxBHVjR2Ij-g4_mAIqji5masxfSPssbMoTCVJgPIi0X9E0Ppv4U4S4y3lSPwq_GWNv7trHSGo0mascPW6BKCw40dXr9NzC2LiJnCJbH5GYAuPrH3aI17SOPMBMBtCbv2W2_waMSI2W0caeXITpgOU89t2JR9xo7dQEV1hryXFmog%3D%3D)__**

Peter,

Big news out of Michigan: Will Lawrence has been added to the DCCC’s Red
to Blue program, recognizing MI-07 as one of Democrats’ key opportunities
to flip a House seat this November.

Will is taking on Republican Congressman Tom Barrett in one of the most
competitive districts in the country, and he’s building the kind of
campaign that can win.

A lifelong Michigander and longtime community organizer, Will has spent
his career fighting for working people. He co-founded the Sunrise
Movement, helped organize tenants facing eviction and homelessness, and
helped secure billions in federal investment for Michigan jobs.

Now, he’s running for Congress to make the basics of a good life
affordable again, from housing and healthcare to good jobs and a healthy
environment.

And he’s doing it without taking corporate PAC money.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260917-2-ak.bJLShi&amount=10&refcode=em20260917-3213&t=1004&akid=3217%2E251025%2EKFu0UO ]I’m proud to support Will Lawrence. Will you join me by splitting a
contribution between our campaign and Will’s campaign today?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260917-2-ak.bJLShi&amount=10&refcode=em20260917-3213&t=1023&akid=3217%2E251025%2EKFu0UO ]Donate $10 ››

Being named to Red to Blue is a sign of just how competitive this race has
become. But winning a battleground district like MI-07 will take the
resources to communicate with voters, organize across the district, and
fight back against the corporate and special-interest money pouring into
this race.

Will can flip this seat. Let’s help him do it.

Thank you,

Abdul

This is the governing body overseeing the National Science Foundation, one of the most important scientific institutions in the United States — **and he fired all of them. At once.** The National Science Board exists for a reason. It oversees billions in federal research funding, advises Congress on science policy, and helps ensure taxpayer dollars support real, evidence-based innovation. **Now that independence is being stripped away.** Let me say this clearly: When political leaders start dismantling independent science institutions, it doesn’t just hurt scientists. It hurts all of us — because that means fewer medical breakthroughs, less climate research, slower progress on cancer treatments, degraded pandemic preparedness, and more. **As a microbiologist and educator, take it from me: Science only works when it is allowed to be independent, transparent, and guided by evidence — not politics.** But what we’re seeing now is a systematic effort to replace expertise with loyalty, and it’s happening at the highest levels of government. **This is exactly why I’m running for Congress.
