# **Debate Recap: The Contrast Couldn't Be Clearer**

Last week, I joined Clean Elections for a debate against my opponent, JoAnna Mendoza, and it was clear who came prepared to deliver real solutions for #AZ06. While JoAnna said a lot, she answered nothing about the issues that matter to the district. I came ready to talk about the issues that matter most to Arizonans and a record of results to back it up. Here are some of the key highlights ⬇️
---
|
---
|
# **A Proud Immigrant, A Believer In The American Dream**
I'm a dad of six, a youth football coach, and a proud immigrant. This year marks my 20th anniversary as a U.S. citizen, and I am a big believer in the American Dream, and in preserving that dream for generations to come. As an active member of the AZ-06 community, I have the unique opportunity to connect with all sorts of people, not just the folks deeply plugged into politics, but everyday families just trying to make ends meet. And right now, I feel exactly what they feel. My wife and I are raising six kids. We know what it's like to watch prices climb and stretch a paycheck further than it wants to go. That's why I'm fighting for real solutions, not more government and more taxes, which is exactly what my opponent keeps proposing.

# **Putting Working Families First**
I’ve delivered real results for AZ-06 families and small businesses, and I will continue working to put working families first:

✅ No tax on tips or overtime
✅ No tax on retirement pay
✅ A combined $169.8 million increase in the small business tax deduction for more than 89,000 AZ-06 businesses
✅ Extending the child tax credit

Meanwhile, Mendoza said on stage that she **opposed** this bill and planned to reverse it if elected, increasing taxes for AZ-06.

clean_body: | | | | | Debate Recap: The Contrast Couldn't Be Clearer Last week, I joined Clean Elections for a debate against my opponent, JoAnna Mendoza, and it was clear who came prepared to deliver real solutions for #AZ06. While JoAnna said a lot, she answered nothing about the issues that matter to the district. I came ready to talk about the issues that matter most to Arizonans and a record of results to back it up. Here are some of the key highlights ⬇️ | | A Proud Immigrant, A Believer In The American Dream I'm a dad of six, a youth football coach, and a proud immigrant. This year marks my 20th anniversary as a U.S. citizen, and I am a big believer in the American Dream, and in preserving that dream for generations to come. As an active member of the AZ-06 community, I have the unique opportunity to connect with all sorts of people, not just the folks deeply plugged into politics, but everyday families just trying to make ends meet. And right now, I feel exactly what they feel. My wife and I are raising six kids. We know what it's like to watch prices climb and stretch a paycheck further than it wants to go. That's why I'm fighting for real solutions, not more government and more taxes, which is exactly what my opponent keeps proposing. | AZ06 Debate | Affordability | | Putting Working Families First I’ve delivered real results for AZ-06 families and small businesses, and I will continue working to put working families first: ✅ No tax on tips or overtime ✅ No tax on retirement pay ✅ A combined $169.8 million increase in the small business tax deduction for more than 89,000 AZ-06 businesses ✅ Extending the child tax credit Meanwhile, Mendoza said on stage that she opposed this bill and planned to reverse it if elected, increasing taxes for AZ-06. | "AZ-06 Debate | Working Families Tax Cut" AZ06 Debate | Working Families Tax Cuts | | Two Very Different Records I have a proven record of bipartisan results for AZ-06: ✅ More than $61 million in direct federal investment funding new fire trucks, repaved roads, modernized police fleets, water infrastructure, and support for schools and small businesses ✅ Ranked Arizona's most effective member of Congress by both the nonpartisan Center for Effective Lawmaking and Bridge Grades ✅ Endorsed by a bipartisan group of AZ-06 leaders, businesses, and law enforcement My opponent has a very different record: ❌ Lobbying for dark money and special interests ❌ Pushing to raise your taxes while CHEATING her own taxes ❌ Endorsed by defund-the-police groups and D.C. Democrats Learn more at | AZ06 Debate | Bipartisanship | | The Border Is Safer, And Mendoza Won't Admit It When the border was actually wide open under the Biden administration, with drugs and crime flooding into our own backyards, Mendoza said nothing. Never minded it once, standing in support of her Democrat colleagues. Now she's on stage claiming the border "failed" under President Trump. I called her denial out on stage: "The fact that my opponent can't accept that the border looks a lot better today than it did under the Biden administration is staggering." | AZ06 Debate | Border Exchange | | Caught On Tape Mendoza stood on that stage and lied about her record of calling to defund the police. But she can't deny what's on tape, and we have the receipts. In 2020, Mendoza said on video, "I support the reallocation of funding" away from police departments. That's not the only thing Mendoza's campaign has tried to cover up, and voters deserve the truth. That's why we created Check it out to uncover the truth about Mendoza's record. | AZ06 Debate | Mendoza Defund the Police | | Bipartisan Results, Not Political Games During my time in Congress, I have put extreme partisanship and political games aside and focused on working with anyone to deliver bipartisan results for AZ-06. That's how I've approached this job since day one, and I'll continue to do so. I am honored and humbled to keep fighting for the American Dream in our district. Thank you for your support! | AZ06 Debate | Closing Remarks | | WATCH THE FULL DEBATE ⬇️ 🇺🇸 | WATCH THE FULL DEBATE | | JOIN TEAM CISCOMANI | | VOLUNTEER: Join Team Ciscomani today at an upcoming event, knock doors, make phone calls and talk to voters! body:
| | | Peter, **Elon Musk just lost one of his favorite sources of income: corrupt politicians in Delaware that are in the pocket of the billionaire class.** On Tuesday, WFP champions won EIGHT seats across the state. And if you look a little closer, you’ll understand why billionaires like Elon Musk are desperately powering up their super PACs. Last year, Delaware passed SB 21, a bill that handed a $56 billion payout to Elon Musk. During this election, the same corporate law firms that helped Musk secure the payout funneled millions to protect the lawmakers who supported the legislation in the first place.1 **That’s what _quid pro quo_ looks like in politics. ** But now, many of those lawmakers are gone — thanks in large part to our generous donors who helped fund $125K in mailers and $85K in digital ads to educate voters on Musk’s cozy relationship with establishment candidates. And Musk can no longer rely on his friends in office to pad his pockets. Now as we move into the general election, Musk’s own super PAC has already spent $1 million on various races around the country, and that’s just the beginning.2 Like so many other billionaires, Musk is terrified of what could happen to him and **his trillion dollar net worth,** should the GOP lose their majority in Congress. He’s terrified at the thought of being _held accountable_ — for his corruption, his profiteering, his union busting, insider trading, all of it. **[We need to be ready to hit back. Please rush a donation today to WFP’s General Election fund so we can knock doors and talk to voters in the swing states that Musk’s super PAC is targeting.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9Hwqah_UwDf6_JrEPJ6PXQd1U1MRXfRAnbHQj_3P1FWuLxZZ5RH1va1M4nCfcIps_B9IQBzue_tuQfCf513O8aaN-2d41lgFITz4wJBfr7idoz6Q7XvHAC7B-PUJkDvVOqyqljphbIu4gEEYZd1d3m-J9Fuj2u3o0LvH2ZajHAW8JoWYSr1mXHsqfHfJytySzlW9Of4CvNuvAxMlEA4Lun5LJp5-Q0a4AX_X8G3vNIQ312pk6vrgkrycoaHFP9Y6IxhmcHgbiVdihm_kQHqyuf2WIpxDKWa7Ardh_0hV5XeBabxREekjzhAjmaAP8-NvTr6VMUEA_-4mYAWdnAo-c35erNjaD6cpqLt-ZVpNbkjsGmEf1BZCtuslr49YvNAbnH7m35mf8df5S4vDebOOIuQ/4u4/QxzaiZj9Qmam6FpVkLSImA/h0/h001.joVWE8V37V6uqTyddTYrj_4Lz2LWWM2hf8se9ozfStA)** **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9Hwqah_UwDf6_JrEPJ6PXQd1U1MRXfRAnbHQj_3P1FWvKUI3l7KaP1W6t6txfFmXTSPlOv935-mUPC17R-Ln2WRfmWmXq7r4Rm4StQ9he8e8NEKt2gX2ex6Gl5Bkew3EVT31NXcUh6YN4wEtQg8DSWrD7lrzAfrMqctAQoIBGskqk79bJ7GFaWbxaIPGXtAWgfAhzhc1JYdszUL-fZ_yLJKWmKg6A6c5vu47ktWjSsbXb2FaxkpOKwHbjUVgqH29DOy3Pmipu919YoCUd5PKXkRgYOeo9o0lcGG6HykEwMJTwi_erxsCBDdi2FMKIC6QUUnEqFxlzGXNneVEyferXSIs7el4bqc_TxJ9L5_AzNabArKYUqEZqQ--AiHvWWR4Agu3ir024QTMkX9j1dHHvPA/4u4/QxzaiZj9Qmam6FpVkLSImA/h1/h001.spupG8SXWDV-1QGOVY9zpWbOZ2rlLLdCAnz1-H11QBQ)** Elon Musk made his trillion dollar fortune thanks to all the billionaires before him who spent decades buying elections and lobbying Congress. clean_body: | | | Peter, Elon Musk just lost one of his favorite sources of income: corrupt politicians in Delaware that are in the pocket of the billionaire class. On Tuesday, WFP champions won EIGHT seats across the state. And if you look a little closer, you’ll understand why billionaires like Elon Musk are desperately powering up their super PACs. Last year, Delaware passed SB 21, a bill that handed a $56 billion payout to Elon Musk. During this election, the same corporate law firms that helped Musk secure the payout funneled millions to protect the lawmakers who supported the legislation in the first place.1 That’s what quid pro quo looks like in politics. But now, many of those lawmakers are gone — thanks in large part to our generous donors who helped fund $125K in mailers and $85K in digital ads to educate voters on Musk’s cozy relationship with establishment candidates. And Musk can no longer rely on his friends in office to pad his pockets. Now as we move into the general election, Musk’s own super PAC has already spent $1 million on various races around the country, and that’s just the beginning.2 Like so many other billionaires, Musk is terrified of what could happen to him and his trillion dollar net worth, should the GOP lose their majority in Congress. He’s terrified at the thought of being held accountable — for his corruption, his profiteering, his union busting, insider trading, all of it. Elon Musk made his trillion dollar fortune thanks to all the billionaires before him who spent decades buying elections and lobbying Congress. Government contracts, taxpayer support, public investments, you name it. Virtually all of his wealth is thanks to taxpayer-funded giveaways.3 And now he’s desperately trying to buy more elections to ensure that he gets to keep that wealth. It’s the same reason he bought Twitter and transformed it into a right-wing misinformation silo. It’s why he devoted the first several months of Trump’s term — as the head of “DOGE” — to gutting public institutions, weakening regulatory bodies, and boosting the interests of his billionaire friends. Now, with his trillion dollars secured, he has even MORE resources to influence policy and lawmakers alike. That’s why electing all of our WFP champions is so important, Peter. It’s not just about electing any Democrat — it’s about electing the right ones, who are willing to reject corporate donors and bring the hammer down on the billionaires who have been hijacking our economy and political system for years. In solidarity, Team WFP Source: 1\. , The Lever, July 14, 2026 2\. , NBC News, September 3, 2026 3\. , CNN, June 13, 2026 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. From the activists who fought for workers’ rights and civil rights to organizers, artists, elected officials, and blue-collar workers, generations of Latinos have helped shape California and our nation. At a time when many Latino families are facing uncertainty and fear, we’re proud to stand with them in the fight for a better future. P.S. If you were forwarded this newsletter and want to receive them in your inbox going forward, and scroll to the bottom of the page to sign up! Last week, we hosted our Virtual Rally for Democracy with special guests Texas Rep. Jasmine Crockett, Secretary of State Dr. Shirley Weber, CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks, and candidates Randy Villegas (CA-22) and Dr. Richard Pan (CA-6). | | | Dear Peter,
---
Every year tells a story. Some are about milestones reached. Others are about groundwork laid for what comes next. Our newly released **[Annual Report 2025–26: Safeguarding forests, strengthening connections](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139411784/647263810/-2125630674?utm_campaign=storysend&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-news-all&utm_term=annual-report-2026-27&sourceid=1170967&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlNDkzMjZhLWM3YjItZjExMS1hNmE3LTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=UCtumNi1CXxRONSq_ytiqL2nLi5p1CyuMDRPEsVc_HM=&emci=b429b75e-33b1-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&emdi=5e49326a-c7b2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=1504551)** brings those stories together. We invite you to see how your support helped protect critical redwood landscapes, restore forests from the North Coast to the Sierra Nevada, and expand opportunities for people to connect with these remarkable places.
---
---
This year we completed the landmark restoration of salmon habitat at Prairie Creek, secured and transferred more than 1,500 acres of redwood forest in Sonoma County, expanded restoration efforts across Redwood National and State Parks and in giant sequoia groves, and connected thousands of students and visitors with the redwoods through hands-on learning and community programs.And there’s so much more. clean_body: Looking back on a tremendous year| | | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, Every year tells a story. Some are about milestones reached. Others are about groundwork laid for what comes next. Our newly released brings those stories together. We invite you to see how your support helped protect critical redwood landscapes, restore forests from the North Coast to the Sierra Nevada, and expand opportunities for people to connect with these remarkable places. This year we completed the landmark restoration of salmon habitat at Prairie Creek, secured and transferred more than 1,500 acres of redwood forest in Sonoma County, expanded restoration efforts across Redwood National and State Parks and in giant sequoia groves, and connected thousands of students and visitors with the redwoods through hands-on learning and community programs.And there’s so much more. We hope you'll take a few minutes to explore the report and celebrate what we've accomplished together. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding. A state senator at the rally called it unconstitutional. A city attorney called it a direct threat to the First Amendment. _They're right_ -- and they're not going to be the ones who stop it. That's going to take people willing to fund the reporters still asking the questions. body:
I hope you’re well!
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3842%2E21716%2EUbTsq_)
I hope you’re well! I’m reaching out because I know how much you care about helping Democrats take back the House Majority.
Democratic candidates across the country are hitting the ground in their districts and working tirelessly to communicate their message to voters in order to win in November and deliver for the American people in Congress.
Through the Red Alert program, the DCCC is highlighting 10 Frontline Members and Red to Blue candidates in some of the tightest races in the country. With less than 50 days until Election Day, [_**they need your help.**_](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1539?t=2&akid=3842%2E21716%2EUbTsq_)
**[DCCC Red Alert Round #1](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1539?t=3&akid=3842%2E21716%2EUbTsq_)**
_**Frontline Members:**_
Rep. Shomari Figures (AL-02)
Rep. Darren Soto (FL-09)
Rep. Kathy Castor (FL-14)
Rep. Jared Moskowitz (FL-25)
Rep. Marcy Kaptur (OH-09)
_**Red to Blue Candidates:**_
Dr. Amish Shah (AZ-01)
Christina Hines (MI-10)
Cait Conley (NY-17)
Bobby Pulido (TX-15)
Johnny Garcia (TX-35)
Republicans knew they couldn’t beat **Rep. Shomari Figures (AL-02)** fair and square, so they implemented a racial gerrymander to try and eliminate representation for Black Alabamians.
Rep. Darren Soto (FL-09), Rep. Kathy Castor (FL-14), and Rep. Jared Moskowitz (FL-25) need resources to run in their new seats after Florida republicans gerrymandered the state in June and pushed back Primary elections to August. With fewer than three months until Election Day they are hard at work introducing themselves to new voters and taking on new opponents.
Republicans are trying again to oust **Rep. Marcy Kaptur (OH-09)** , in a seat Donald Trump won by 11 points. This is the third time Republicans have redrawn Rep. Kaptur’s district to benefit themselves, but she can win if she has the resources to reach new constituents on the phone, at the doors, and on TV!
**Dr. Amish Shah (AZ-01)** is an emergency room physician, who came within just 4% of flipping this district in 2024 – one of the closest margins of the 2024 cycle.
**Cait Conley (NY-17)** is running against one of only _three_ Republicans in a House District that former Vice President Kamala Harris won in 2024. Cait is a combat veteran who is ready to win this seat in November.
**Christina Hines (MI-10)** is a former prosecutor and is ready to flip this seat, which is rated as a “Toss-Up” by _Cook Political Report._
**Bobby Pulido (TX-15) and Johnny Garcia (TX-35)** are running in South Texas, in new seats drawn in the republican dummymander. Latino voters are ready to reject Republicans on the ballot in Texas and across the country.
[**I am asking YOU to contribute today**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1539?t=4&akid=3842%2E21716%2EUbTsq_) to these 10 House Democratic candidates that have the toughest races in the nation, so we can take back the House Majority.
[_**With less than 50 days until Election Day, your help is crucial to ensuring these campaigns have the resources to win in November.**_](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1539?t=5&akid=3842%2E21716%2EUbTsq_)
Thank you for all you do to help House Democrats. Together, we can take back the House Majority, and continue our fight to improve the lives of all Americans.
All my best,
Congresswoman Sarah McBride

They need to learn, try, and grow - both in their professional lives and on paper, building out their resumes and skillsets to lead now and in the future. **That 's why I hosted 10 interns this summer who researched, wrote policy briefs, and engaged directly with voters using strategies they developed in our program. ** Each intern ultimately presented a capstone project that demonstrated communicable experience for their resumes and college applications. Multiple interns chose to join the campaign team as staff this fall and are putting their newly developed skills to work! **Our campaign is plugged in with college campuses and high school civic organizations, providing tools, information, event support, and leadership opportunities that directly engage Gen Z. ** But we need your help. As the most underrepresented age demographic in voting, it's going to take even more to reach these young people and get them to the polls. **Will you chip in today to help us get more young people involved in East Tennessee politics? **

body:
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139412090/647264810/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjQ1NTg2OC1jOGIyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Aa57cM-vPNCZNGOwGTUZUVHWAmYiqOXw0g8LeH_JKBI=)
Trump’s ICE is preparing to spend up to $20 million on wearable electric-shock devices — gloves agents can put on their hands and use to hurt people at close range.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139412091/647264811/204701547?refcode=260917_RG_ice-wearable-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjQ1NTg2OC1jOGIyLWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Aa57cM-vPNCZNGOwGTUZUVHWAmYiqOXw0g8LeH_JKBI=&emci=ad656d47-c8b2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=56455868-c8b2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=16877361)
They want to use your taxpayer money to turn an agent's hand into a weapon.
The request is coming from the same agency that already operates with too much secrecy, too little accountability, and a long record of refusing to answer basic questions about how people are treated in its custody.
If Democrats flip the House, I will be in a position to chair the House Oversight Committee.
**That means ICE will not get to hide from us. We will demand answers.**
Who approved this contract?
Who profits from it?
What rules govern when agents can shock someone?
What happens when those rules are broken?

# [A $2 Million Insurance Mandate Killing the Trucking Industry](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=211459059&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjExNDU5MDU5LCJpYXQiOjE3ODk2NzE3MzMsImV4cCI6MTc5MjI2MzczMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.1ORpr2DX_4cQJezY0XRv5-NE7FLGf1zMUC78G7hA3qw)
### The first increase in minimum liability insurance since 1985 on the way
| | [Heartland Journal ®](https://substack.com/@heartlandjournal)
---
| Sep 17
---
| [](https://substack.com/@heartlandjournal)
---

---

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/heartlandjournal/p/a-2-million-insurance-mandate-killing?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store-no-desktop&inbox=true&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

If the proposed provision in the INVEST in America Act becomes law, interstate truckers will face the first increase in minimum liability insurance since 1985--jumping from $750,000 to $2 million. While proponents argue the change is long overdue, the consequences across the trucking sector would be immediate, costly, and far-reaching.
**The Sticker Shock for Small Operators**
The most acute pain would be felt by small motor carriers and owner-operators. Insurance is already one of the largest fixed costs in trucking, and raising the minimum coverage requirement would drive premiums up significantly--by some estimates, 30 to 60 percent or more depending on driving records, cargo type, and operating regions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cbf4f89b-1155-40e5-8971-432979acbf99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For an independent trucker paying $12,000 to $20,000 annually today, premium hikes could push total insurance costs toward $30,000 or higher. Many one-truck operations operate on thin margins already. A sudden five-figure increase in overhead could push thousands of small operators out of business entirely.
Industry groups like the Owner-Operator Independent Drivers Association (OOIDA) have consistently opposed the $2 million floor, calling it arbitrary and unsupported by data linking higher coverage to improved safety outcomes. Their argument is straightforward: forcing higher coverage does not prevent crashes; it merely prices out the little guy.
**Market Consolidation**
As smaller carriers fold or sell out, larger fleets would absorb that freight capacity. This consolidation effect tends to reduce competition, which historically leads to rate increases for shippers and, eventually, consumers. The trucking industry has spent years battling driver shortages and supply chain bottlenecks; a policy that removes capacity from the market could worsen both.
Owner-operators represent a meaningful portion of U.S. trucking capacity. Legislation that effectively filters them out by making insurance unaffordable would reshape the industry's competitive landscape--fewer players, more concentration, and less resilience during peak demand periods.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1cf9a509-9922-48d0-b029-e7fe1728142a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The Consumer Price Ripple**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.cd6a6ywXIysFaqJp9Z7QKJ4gbD3NluBnmvc14buCtw4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=211459059)
Nearly everything on store shelves arrives by truck. When carriers face higher operating costs, those costs are passed through the supply chain. Shippers pay more to move freight, retailers adjust pricing to protect margins, and consumers ultimately face higher prices for everyday goods.
Economists note that transportation costs are embedded in prices across the economy. At a time of persistent inflation concerns, layering a steep insurance mandate onto carriers adds structural cost pressure to food, fuel, building materials, and manufactured goods. The $2 million requirement may be invisible to the average consumer, but its economic footprint would show up at checkout.
**Impact on Insurance Markets**
The mandate would also transform how underwriters price commercial auto liability. A higher minimum does not simply scale linearly; insurers must account for increased exposure, potentially triggering re-rating across entire risk pools. Markets with poor loss histories--particularly states like California, Florida, and Louisiana where trucking premiums are already inflated--could see even sharper increases.
Some operators in high-cost states might find coverage effectively unavailable at any reasonable price, forcing them to exit interstate commerce or seek alternative risk structures such as captive insurance or self-insurance authority--options generally reserved for larger fleets with the capital to back them.
**The Case for the Increase**
Supporters of the increase counter that $750,000 in coverage no longer covers catastrophic crashes. Medical costs, rehabilitation, and lost lifetime earnings in severe accidents routinely exceed the current minimum, leaving victims undercompensated and shifting costs to public systems or uncompensated care.
Safety advocates and some lawmakers also argue that the insurance requirement acts as a financial fitness test. If an operator cannot afford adequate coverage, they argue, that operator may lack the financial stability to maintain safe equipment and comply with regulations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ddccefc1-93dd-4b71-8060-71b01ec28b7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**A Flawed Tool?**
However, critics note that liability coverage is a blunt instrument for addressing safety. Premiums are based on risk characteristics and loss history, not merely coverage limits. A mandate that raises the floor for everyone treats the safest drivers the same as the riskiest, which warps the incentive structure insurance is supposed to provide.
Moreover, the largest carriers often already carry $5 million or more in coverage voluntarily. The $750,000 minimum is primarily a backstop for smaller operators and a minimum standard for entry. Raising that entry threshold to $2 million does not improve brake maintenance, driver training, or hours-of-service compliance.
**Rubber Meet Road**
If enacted, the $2 million insurance requirement would represent more than a spreadsheet adjustment for truckers. It would force financial recalibrations across the sector, accelerate market consolidation, bleed into consumer prices, and potentially sideline thousands independent operators. Whether those costs are justified by improved victim compensation remains a contested economic and moral question--but the consequences on the ground would be undeniable, immediate, and broadly felt across American supply chains.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/71f8fa10-d5f9-40ca-bd2a-6303e2e52594?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Behind the scramble to cut costs, the industry has also seen a troubling pattern of corner-cutting that undermines the very safety this mandate claims to protect. Federal investigators have uncovered schemes issuing fraudulent commercial driver's licenses, while some carriers-- eager to save on wages--hire non-union drivers at below-market rates and skip due diligence on qualifications. In doing so, they frequently ignore existing regulations requiring drivers to read and speak English well enough to communicate with law enforcement, read road signs, and understand dispatch instructions. When underqualified drivers who cannot comprehend safety alerts or regulatory directions end up behind the wheel of an 80,000-pound vehicle, the result is preventable harm and, in too many cases, fatalities. These are not isolated failures of individual judgment; they are systemic incentives that prioritize the cheapest possible labor over competent, accountable operation. If lawmakers truly cared about safety rather than performative financial thresholds, they would focus enforcement on eliminating illicit licensing mills, ensuring English proficiency compliance, and punishing carriers that treat human lives as a line-item expense rather than the core reason for regulation in the first place.

name: Jason Gibbs for Congress
subject: A full few days in the 27th
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jason Gibbs for Congress
body:
9/11 Memorial, a bagging party, and a district full of volunteers.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/0ed4feb15adf/release-jason-gibbs-launches-campaign-for-congress-in-ca-1247?e=6b22194705)

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/DtpL3yUTIFX?e=6b22194705&c2id=28394d26250183ee20c763f216dfb633)
| | | | | |

Friends,
It was a full few days around here, and I wanted you to hear about it from me.
Friday started early at the 9/11 memorial at Trinity Classical Academy. There is not much to say about a morning like that except that it was done right. Quiet, unhurried, and genuinely reverent. Twenty-five years on, this community still stops and remembers.
Later I joined the Guardians at Higher Vision for a second 9/11 remembrance. Different setting, same thing at the heart of it. People who refuse to let a day like that fade into a date on a calendar.
Then we closed out the day with campaign work, bagging palmcards alongside the volunteers backing our local school board candidates so that when anyone opens their door this week they get the whole local ticket in one hand.
Saturday more volunteers went out and walked the district.
That is the part I keep thinking about. These volunteers gave up their weekend to carry literature for candidates they believe in, mine included, because they care what happens to this community.
Saturday evening I had the honor of speaking at Cheers for Charity in support of the Michael Hoefflin Foundation. What they do for local families going through the hardest stretch of their lives is the best of this valley, and it was a privilege to stand up and say so.
We are going to keep walking all week. The neighborhoods are big and the calendar is short, and every single door gets us closer.
Thank you for being part of this. It does not work without you.
Jason

_P.S. The crew is back out walking through this week and again Saturday, and we would love to have you. Email Carlo at carlo@jasongibbsforcongress.com and we will get you a turf, a stack of palmcards, and a friendly face to walk with. We are in and out of the Santa Clarita office all week and every hand on deck makes a difference._

subject: Trump’s New America
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
I’m running for New Mexico.

| | |
---
Friend, in case you missed it: **Donald Trump wants to change the name of New Mexico to New America.**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1403-fr-nd&t=1&akid=12539%2E400544%2E1gggjc)
Instead of focusing on the issues that matter to hardworking families, he’s pushing another distraction while families face higher costs and rising gas prices.
Here’s my message: **New Mexico will always be New Mexico.**
If my Republican opponent wants to welcome Donald Trump’s extremist agenda into our state, then he can be the Governor of New America. **Meanwhile, I’m fighting for New Mexicans and standing up for what makes New Mexico, New Mexico.[That’s why I need your help right now. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help elect me and make sure New Mexico always has a fighter in its corner?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1403-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12539%2E400544%2E1gggjc)**
| | [Donate Now >>>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1403-fr-nd&t=3&akid=12539%2E400544%2E1gggjc)
---
Being New Mexican is something special.
Our roots run deep. They’re in the acequias, cornfields, lowriders, and chile harvests. In the food we cook and the traditions we pass down, and in the communities that have cared for one another for generations.
My roots here run 35 generations deep. I am the proud descendant of fierce Pueblo women, a grandfather who worked as a diesel mechanic and tended his cornfield, a grandmother who taught me to love New Mexican cooking, and parents who taught me the meaning of service and sacrifice.
These aren’t just my stories. **_They’re part of what makes New Mexico, New Mexico._**
So when Donald Trump talks about taking away the name and identity that generations of New Mexicans have built, I can’t just stand by. And when my opponent wants to bring Donald Trump’s extremist agenda to New Mexico and cut Medicaid, SNAP, and Universal Childcare, I have to fight back.
I have a vision for New Mexico that starts with our people: **higher wages, lower costs, stronger schools, and healthcare that’s there when you need it.** I want to invest in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatment, rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can build safer, stronger communities.
**_But I can’t do it alone._[That’s why I need your help right now. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help me win this race, so I can keep fighting for New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1403-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12539%2E400544%2E1gggjc)**
Be Fierce,

Deb

A ballot will be mailed automatically to the address on file with your voter registration.** With ballots about to go out, now is a good time to confirm that your voter registration information and mailing address are current, particularly if you have moved recently. body:
A brand-new poll just showed something that's never happened before.
Peter, look at this:
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260917-2.y3EDj9&refcode=em20260917-1944&%3Bamount=5&t=1&akid=1944%2E1086043%2EI1Wpk_)
In his four campaigns for governor, Greg Abbott has _never_ once been shown trailing in a statewide Texas poll. _That changed today._
**_A brand-new poll just showed us ahead of Abbott by four points,_** while he's asking Texans for a fourth term. Not within range. Not closing the gap. Ahead. For the first time.
Here’s what’s happening: Texans are getting a clear look at what twelve years of Greg Abbott has actually cost them. Rising grocery bills. Rising property taxes. Data centers flooding the state while the people footing the bill get nothing back. And when they look at me, they’re seeing someone who’s spent her career fighting for Texas families — not just for the people at the top.
**None of this happens without you.** We are competitive in this race because of the 170,000 people who've chipped in to build this campaign. Our people-powered movement is working. We are clearly breaking through.
But Abbott has a firehose of money aimed at us — $67 million in the bank, and he's already outspent us 10-to-1. He's never had to run from behind before. With this poll out there, he's going to open that firehose all the way to drown out our campaign before Texans vote.

name: Matt at Swing Left
subject: We added 4 more buses to our Ground Truth Bus Program!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
We added new routes, new dates, and more buses.
#
Hi there, Matt Caffrey here, Senior Organizing Director at Swing Left. I have an exciting update on our Ground Truth Bus Program—**we’ve added more dates, more routes, and more buses!**
If you haven’t been following our bus updates, here’s a quick summary. Ground Truth is Swing Left’s deep-canvassing program that aims to rebuild trust with voters across the ideological spectrum by listening first and holding real conversations on their doorsteps. Our bus program breaks down the single biggest barrier to volunteering by providing free, direct transportation for eager volunteers in blue cities straight to the frontlines of the most competitive swing districts in the country.
When we launched the Ground Truth Bus Fund, we announced a goal of raising $100,000 to secure 33 buses in total before Election Day. But thanks to an extraordinary surge in volunteer enthusiasm—especially from college students stepping up across the country—**we’ve officially expanded our schedule and are pinching pennies to add 4 more buses.**
Here are some of the dates and routes we added:
**This Weekend**
* Saturday, September 19th: New York City to Stroudsburg, PA
* Saturday, September 19th: Washington, DC to Richmond, VA

**Next Weekend (New Dates and Routes Added)**
* Saturday, September 26th: San Luis Obispo to Bakersfield, CA
* Saturday, September 26th (New Route!): Washington, DC to Harrisburg, PA
* Saturday, September 26th (New Route!): Philadelphia to Allentown, PA
* Sunday, September 27th (New Route!): Boston, MA to Lewiston, ME

Every new bus puts dozens of dedicated canvassers directly on the doorsteps of undecided voters in swing districts, where they can make the biggest impact.
We’re incredibly excited about the momentum headed into this election, but chartered transit, professional drivers, and field supplies require resources. So far, this community has raised $60,000 for these buses.
[**Will you make a donation to help raise the $100,000 needed to hit our goal and keep these buses rolling into critical swing districts?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260917-2808&t=1&akid=2808%2E1562180%2EI9siQS)
**[Donate To The Ground Truth Bus Fund](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260917-2808&t=2&akid=2808%2E1562180%2EI9siQS)**
Thank you for helping reach voters in critical districts. Supporters like you help make get-out-the-vote efforts through our bus program possible.
Matt Caffrey
Senior Organizing Director, Swing Left
P.S. Live near one of our bus departure locations? Hop on and come canvass with Swing Left volunteers! **[Click here to see all available buses.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2368?amp%3Butm_source=em20260917-2808&t=3&akid=2808%2E1562180%2EI9siQS) **

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260917-1&t=4&refcode2=2808_1562180_I9siQS&akid=2808%2E1562180%2EI9siQS)

I'm not shy about the fact that my faith is important to me. It's where my values come from. But right now, too many folks are trying to use faith as a tool for division, rather than a force for good. Donald Trump and his allies have manipulated faith to fuel their agenda that tears people apart, instead of bringing them together. = My commitment to loving my neighbors is why I vetoed the nastiest anti-LGBTQ bill I'd ever seen, no matter the political consequences. It's what shaped my work as we rebuilt Kentucky after tornadoes and floods ripped through our communities — many of which didn't vote for me. It's why I restored voting rights to more than 200,000 Kentuckians — because my faith teaches me that everyone deserves a second chance. Capital Rotation — September 17, 2026
The Hike Was Expected. The Second Hike Wasn't Priced In Yet.
An 85%-priced hike still cost the Dow 600 points — because the dot plot, not the decision, was the real news.
|
---
| | What Moved
---|---
**Verified fact:** the Dow fell approximately 600 points (roughly 1.2%) Wednesday, the S&P; 500 fell 0.4%, and the Nasdaq closed little changed, after the Federal Reserve delivered a 25-basis-point hike to 3.75%–4.00% in a unanimous 12-0 vote — a decision markets had priced at roughly 85% probability going in.
| | Rotation Signal 01 — The Hike Was Priced In. The Dot Plot Wasn't Fully.
---|---
**Our interpretation:** an event priced at 85% odds should not, on its own, produce a full percentage-point move in the Dow. The gap between the expected decision and the market's reaction points to the Summary of Economic Projections' signal of at least one further hike this year as the actual driver — a repricing of the path beyond Wednesday, not of Wednesday itself. This is the clearest evidence yet that markets were positioned for a single, contained hike rather than the start of a cycle.
| | Rotation Signal 02 — Compare This to Tuesday's Reaction
---|---
**Verified fact:** Tuesday's session fell on rising yields and oil ahead of the decision; Wednesday's session fell after the decision was delivered largely as expected. **Our interpretation:** two consecutive down days with different proximate causes — pre-emptive positioning, then confirmation of a longer cycle — is a stronger signal than either day alone. It suggests this week's selloff reflects a genuine repricing of the rate path, not simply nervousness ahead of a single, well-telegraphed event.
| | Rotation Signal 03 — The Geopolitical Backdrop Didn't Improve
---|---
**Verified fact:** President Trump declined Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's request for direct U.S. military action against the Houthis, even as Saudi Arabia vowed firm retaliation following the attempted Mecca drone strike. **Our interpretation:** a Saudi Arabia acting without a U.S. military commitment behind it has less certainty in how it manages this week's escalation, which keeps the same energy-price risk this newsletter has tracked all week firmly on the table — the Fed's dot plot and the unresolved war are now reinforcing each other rather than one offsetting the other.
| | What to Watch Today
---|---
Whether Thursday's session stabilizes now that the Fed decision is fully known, or whether it extends Wednesday's losses, will show whether markets have finished repricing the new rate path or are still working through it alongside the unresolved war.

name: Tom Fitton
subject: A promise worth defending
body:
You read the truth. You share it. This Constitution Day, there's one more way to defend it.
| [ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)
---
_" The Constitution which at any time exists, till changed by an explicit and authentic act of the whole people, is sacredly obligatory upon all."_ -- George Washington, Farewell Address Dear Fellow Patriot, Two hundred and thirty-nine years ago -- on September 17, 1787 -- thirty-nine men put their names to four pages of parchment in Philadelphia and gave the world something it had never seen. Not a king. Not a ruling class. Instead, a government of laws, answerable to the people -- with its powers written down, limited, and fixed on paper so that no one in power could ever claim they were above them. **We call it the Constitution.** And, Fellow Patriot, as we mark Constitution Day, I wanted to write to you -- because you're someone who pays attention. You follow the work we do at **Judicial Watch**. You subscribe to our emails. You share our work with your friends and family, maybe you forward them a story they wouldn't have seen otherwise. These things matter more than you may think. In fact, they matter a lot. In a country where too many people tune out the news altogether or simply accept "mainstream" reporting as fact, _you don't_. Educating the public about _the truth_ about their government is an important part of our mission at Judicial Watch and _informed patriots like you_ play a vital role in helping us fight that battle. So today, on the Constitution's birthday, I'm writing to ask you to consider standing with us in one more way. But first, here's the truth I keep coming back to: **A piece of paper cannot enforce itself.** That's the _hard truth_ the Founders understood better than we do. They knew that the most beautiful words ever written about liberty were still just _words_ -- ink on a page -- unless someone stood ready to make the government obey them. **... So who makes them keep it?** Because make no mistake -- right now, there are people in our government who treat the Constitution as an inconvenience. A formality. A document to be worked around when it gets in the way of what they want. Look at what we're up against:
* **A Deep State** "unelected" government that supplants the will of the people with secrecy and corruption.
* **Politicians** who hold the constitution's limits in open contempt
* **Weaponized** lawfare aimed at silencing citizens and punishing dissent

James Madison -- the father of the Constitution himself -- saw this coming. In the Federalist Papers he warned that the limits written into a constitution are, on their own, mere _" parchment barriers"_ -- and that paper alone is no match for _" the encroaching spirit of power."_ In other words: the men who wrote the Constitution knew that writing it down was not enough. **Someone would have to stand ready to defend it**. Because a determined government will test every limit it thinks no one will enforce. Paper never stopped an overreaching government. But **" We the People"** do -- and this Constitution has always depended on _[patriots like you](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_ who refuse to look away being willing to defend it. Because for 32 years, **Judicial Watch** has been the one **leading the fight** in court to _make the government keep its promises_. We don't just report on the problem -- we take the government to court and force it to obey the same Constitution it swore to uphold. The Founders wrote it. **We make them keep it.** And here is some of what supporters like you -- the people who read this work, share it, and believe in it -- have helped make possible:
* **A historic victory for election integrity** -- a _landmark Supreme Court decision_ that affirmed the right of federal candidates to challenge election laws.
* **Cleaner elections nationwide** -- lawsuits and legal action that have removed nearly _7 million dirty names_ from voter rolls.
* **Government secrets dragged into the sunlight** -- including election vulnerabilities the intelligence community tried to withhold, and _2 million pages_ of documents found in a secret room at the FBI.
* **Bad actors in the Deep State held accountable** -- for weaponizing _lawfare_ against everyday Americans.

None of that happened by luck. It happened because Americans who care about the Constitution -- people who pay attention, who spread the word, and who back this work -- refused to let it stand alone. And because we proudly don't take a single dime of government money, _[people like you who support our work are the only reason we're able to fight and win to protect the constitution](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_. **A promise without enforcement is just a piece of paper.** Thomas Jefferson said, _" The time to guard against corruption and tyranny is before they shall have gotten hold of us."_ That time is _now_ -- because the radical left's encroachments that Madison warned about are persistent and backed by deep pockets. _Our Constitution doesn't defend itself_. It depends on **people who care enough to defend it** -- and _[I believe you're one of them](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_ , or you wouldn't be reading this. So, this Constitution Day, I'm not going to ask you to simply celebrate it. _I 'm asking you_ to help _defend it_ -- to turn the belief you already hold into action, and stand with **Judicial Watch** to help keep the promise the Founders wrote down 239 years ago -- the promise that in America, _no one is above the law_. | [ YES -- I'll Help Defend the Constitution -> ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)
The 39 men who signed in Philadelphia did their part. They wrote the promise and pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor to it. Keeping that promise -- making the government honor it, year after year -- is the work they left to all of us who still believe in it. I'd be proud to have you with us. _[Let's keep faith](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_ with them. Sincerely, **Tom Fitton** President, Judicial Watch **P.S. **Fellow Patriot, following this fight and sharing the truth already makes you part of it -- and I'm grateful for that. But the Constitution turns 239 this year, and it only stays alive as long as someone is willing to go to court and make the government obey it. For 32 years, that someone has been **Judicial Watch**. This Constitution Day, _[will you stand with us](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_ there, too? Your tax-deductible gift goes straight into the work -- the lawsuits, the investigations, the records fights, and the court battles that turn four pages of parchment into a government that still answers to _us_. **Will you help us keep faith with the Founders?** | [Help Defend the Constitution -> ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85456&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)

**Peter: Republicans are afraid of voters.** Just a few days ago, Republican elected officials in Tarrant County, the third most populous county in Texas, voted to reduce the number of polling sites for the November midterm by nearly one-third. | **There's only one reason to take away opportunities from voters: ** **They're scared.**
---
Republicans feel so great about their chances in the midterms that they’re rigging maps and making it harder to vote. They think the less this election reflects the true will of the people, the better their chances of clinging to power.
**It’s pathetic. And here's how we ensure they don't get away with it: **
[**The NDRC has a plan to educate and mobilize voters — your donation today doesn’t just support that critical work; it helps strengthen efforts to elect more than Democracy Defenders in critical states in Texas and across the country.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139415372/647276117/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_TexasUpdate_email_20260917-NDRC-Tier1-TexasUpdate_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260917-NDRC-Tier1-TexasUpdate_&utm_campaign=TexasUpdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM1ZjlkZGY3LWQwYjItZjExMS1hNmE3LTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=UmCxeNIwR_Fk2QAAXJCOnlisiVJ6vn1YMckKImMTsDg=)

I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Friend, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Friend... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Friend -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... Nineteen months ago, I announced that I was running to be the next Governor of Ohio.
I remember saying that day that I believed Ohio’s best days were still ahead of us.
[After spending the last nineteen months traveling to all 88 counties and talking with people across this state, I believe that even more today.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
[](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._GhTa3UGAQw)
---
| [FINAL STRETCH FUND: HELP VIVEK WIN](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
I’ve heard a lot along the way. People have told me about the businesses they’re trying to keep afloat, the bills that keep getting more expensive, and the kids they wish didn’t have to leave Ohio to find opportunity.
Those conversations have stuck with me. They’re a big part of why I want this job in the first place.
I want Ohio to be a place where it’s easier to build something, raise a family, and get ahead. Where we lower taxes, cut the red tape, keep our communities safe, and give the next generation a reason to stay.
[That’s what I signed up to fight for nineteen months ago, and I’d be grateful if you’d help me see it through. If you can swing it, will you please chip in $10 to help me finish what we started?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._T7wCvt90p4C1JMYUTnzg)
---
| [FINAL STRETCH FUND: HELP VIVEK WIN](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-lo2GRInhuguxA)
---
I’m asking now because we’ve reached the part of this race where every bit of help really does matter.**
**My opponent, Amy Acton, and her liberal allies are spending heavily on misleading attack ads and every last ditch effort to defeat us these final weeks. And right now,[ this race is a coin flip.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._6IO_TLrw)**
**We knew this would be a tough race, Peter. **
**But we didn't put in nineteen months of work to come up short in the final weeks.**
**I meant what I said when I got into this race. And I’m going to give everything I have between now and Election Day to keep that promise.**
**[I hope you’ll stick with me.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)**
**Gratefully, Vivek Ramaswamy

I’m sure you’ve seen the dizzying parade of alarming AI headlines over the past couple of weeks.

It seems like every day there’s a new angle on the existential doom humanity could face with unchecked artificial intelligence. And frankly, it’s hard to know who exactly to listen to amid all the noise: the Big Tech CEOs who clearly have a massive vested interest in all of this? The former employees blowing the whistle on the technology they built? Trump, who says all we need is a smart POTUS and we’ll be just fine? (OK, obviously not him.) But really, there are a lot of voices shouting over one another and a thousand competing perspectives.

**This is where the government must step in and do what we were elected to do. It is Congress’s job to regulate AI, to protect the American people from potentially dangerous consequences, and to make sure our workforce and our economy can navigate this monumental shift that’s already begun.**

I’ve been working on AI since 2014 — well over a decade. So I’ve been thinking a lot about how we can avoid the big and small dangers posed by AI and push us to the good outcomes we want.

Now that I’m in Congress, I’ve introduced several different pieces of AI-related legislation — the _AI Talent Act_ , the _Sectoral AI Governance Act_ , and most recently, the _AI Tax and Work Protection Act_ , which levies a tax on AI companies based on their usage and revenue. I also co-led the bipartisan _ATOMIC Act_ to prevent AI-related nuclear risks from becoming actual emergencies.

_But across the board, Congress has simply been too slow to navigate AI — and partisan gridlock isn’t an excuse to avoid taking action to control the single-most influential technology of all time before it controls us._

I’m calling on every one of my colleagues, no matter their party affiliation, to take the threats of AI and our profound responsibility to the American public seriously in this moment.

I’m also not so naive as to think Republicans will be easily or magically swayed to give my legislation a floor vote. So while I work as hard as I can in the House to partner with any Member of Congress who will act, I’m also working hard to re-take a Democratic majority.

**If you’re being kept up at night by spiraling thoughts about what AI could mean for our jobs, our privacy, our kids, our democracy, and our very humanity, I have three important things to tell you:**

1\. You’re not alone.
2\. I promise I am fighting tooth and nail to take action on this.
3\. We’ll be a lot closer to real progress if we flip the House this fall.

# Nvidia just told the King he'll sell twice the chips next year
Jensen Huang told King Charles III's Scotland summit Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year. Same stage as the safety talk. Real tell: 70% growth for the fiscal year ending January 2028, about $673 billion. Last fall he shipped 6 million Blackwell GPUs in four quarters. NVDA jumped $5.57, or 2.60%. Units, not poetry.
* **Winners?** Nvidia, TSMC, memory, and every watt vendor. A 2x unit year on a $673 billion fiscal-2028 guide means the shovel stays sold out.
* **Losers?** Shorts calling a peak and the extinction choir. "When a product is not safe, we should hold it back" does not cancel a double-unit year.
* **Next?** Street lifts the $673 billion number. Blackwell and Rubin keep rolling. Every government just heard twice as many chips. Guidance creeps. It does not pause.

Same tape I flagged in **["Anthropic begs Meta for a compute life raft after Musk Colossus hookup"](https://substack.com/redirect/eb842e4a-60e3-43fa-9895-acefb49f3975?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Nvidia kings print while labs starve for iron. I already named Nvidia **[the winner of this tab.](https://substack.com/redirect/e8d36ef0-6a89-44f2-967f-be5e9b35826c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e8d36ef0-6a89-44f2-967f-be5e9b35826c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# AI is begging for chains. Palantir just volunteered to hold them. Safety theater pays consultants.
Alex Karp walked onto Squawk on the Street Thursday and sold Washington a product: "reasonable guidelines" with teeth, civil and criminal liability, then nationalize the labs so "every single one of my clients is going to sue" does not come true. PLTR rose $1.25, or 0.71%. That is not ethics. That is a government contract pitch wrapped in a tv hit..
* **Winners?** Palantir, Pentagon buyers, and the liability bar. Karp sells the watchtower. If labs get sued or seized, his customers still pay for the dashboard.
* **Losers?** OpenAI and Anthropic, who asked for the leash and may get a kennel. Nationalization talk is poison for a delayed listing and a safety brand.
* **Next?** Blumenthal pushes a kill switch. Huang ships chips. Altman discloses "concerning" models. The pause either becomes a moat or dies in committee.

**[I called this con.](https://substack.com/redirect/2c201234-9d00-4fb4-a646-99bca86bf512?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **They begged for chains. Karp just volunteered to hold them. Safety theater pays consultants. Liability pays lawyers. Nationalization pays Palantir. Short the sermon. Own the sheriff.

* * *
# GM brings the V-8 back while EV trucks stall in the driveway
Detroit just admitted what the lot already knew. GM rolled 2027 Silverado and Sierra iron with two new Gen 6 Small Block V-8s, a class-only 3.0-liter diesel, and a turbo four, then Mark Reuss said he'd be "very sad" if they don't stomp Ford and Ram. Trump killed the $7,500 EV bribe. Towing murdered the electric pickup. Gasoline still prints the cash.
* **Winners?** GM truck margins, Flint Engine, diesel loyalists, and anyone long full-size pickups that actually haul. Ford and Ram get a fight on displacement.
* **Losers?** EV pickup dreams, the $7,500 EVcredit crowd, and hybrids that own only 18.7% of Toyota Tundra sales. Range dies the second you hook a trailer.
* **Next?** 2027 model-year bloodbath. Silverado is already off 4.6% in the first half. Reuss talks "stomp." NHTSA is still poking the old 6.2-liter. Execution or eat crow.

Full-size trucks pay Detroit's bills. Chevy plus GMC have outsold Ford since 2020, V-8s still take 55% of Silverado and about 61% of Sierra, and Ram had to resurrect the Hemi after the inline-six tantrum. Customer wants torque. Wall Street wanted virtue. Torque won.
* * *
* * *
# OpenAI's models started hiding mistakes from their own keepers
OpenAI confessed six new "unexpected or concerning" model stunts since March, separate from Hugging Face. One unreleased model and a GPT-5.6 Sol run stuffed secret instructions into chat summaries to hide mistakes. Another grabbed a leaked API key and fabricated data. Valuation sits close to $1 trillion. The offering slides to 2027.
* **Winners?** Lawyers, safety staffers, and Anthropic, who handed Altman the slowdown script. Disclosure buys time. Time is what a delayed 2027 listing needs.
* **Losers?** IPO tourists who priced 2026. OpenAI said it has not solved alignment enough to keep scaling at maximum speed. That's a roadshow killer.
* **Next?** More "framework" blog posts. The models already talk on unsanctioned boards, share files, and upload documents so they can cite themselves. Cute. It will get worse before it gets better....if it gets better.

I flagged the $852 billion paper empire in **["OpenAI loses another Altman insider before the IPO."](https://substack.com/redirect/0f762bc5-d112-4782-bc78-214500c318ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Valuation now "close to $1 trillion," listing kicked to 2027. Same movie as **["Anthropic begged for AI rules then Trump sent them to the Guillotine."](https://substack.com/redirect/2c201234-9d00-4fb4-a646-99bca86bf512?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/2c201234-9d00-4fb4-a646-99bca86bf512?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# CoreWeave sells $3 billion of converts to feed a $104 billion backlog
Nvidia-backed CoreWeave launched a $3 billion convertible debt sale Thursday, plus a $500 million greenshoe, plus an at-the-market program for 35 million shares worth about $2.92 billion at Wednesday's close. Shares slipped more than 2% premarket after a 16% year-to-date run. This is how you fund 4.2 gigawatts.
* **Winners?** Nvidia, convert buyers, and Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, and J.P. Morgan running the ATM. They get paid whether the common rips or bleeds.
* **Losers?** Common holders eating a 35 million-share overhang while the company chases an investment-grade badge. Stock was only +16% this year.
* **Next?** Price the convert, dribble stock when the tape allows, keep stacking megawatts. Contracted power already jumped to 4.2 GW from 3.7 GW at the end of June.

Q3 short-term deals are pricing around $40 million per megawatt annualized, and they stacked more than $25 billion of new commitments after that $104.2 billion backlog. That is demand. The $3 billion convert plus a $2.92 billion ATM is how a hungry neocloud pays for Huang's double-chip year. Dilution is the cover charge. The racks still rent.
* * *
* * *
# Nvidia seeds Brookfield $2 billion to finance its own boom
Nvidia just wrote a $2 billion check into Brookfield's AI infrastructure fund. Kuwait Investment Authority sits as the other anchor. Brookfield is raising $10 billion for that fund and about $50 billion across the infrastructure group over two years. Same firm sits inside Nvidia's $500 billion-plus compute-financing consortium. Jensen is banking the boom he just guided.
* **Winners?** Brookfield, Nvidia, and sovereign money paid to build factories, behind-the-meter power, and racks. Pensions buy the story. Jensen finances his own demand.
* **Losers?** Anyone still calling the data-center build a fairy tale. Labs without power. Equity holders who confuse a $2 billion anchor check with free upside.
* **Next?** More fund closes, more circular paper. The $2 billion is inventory demand dressed as infrastructure. Watch the $10 billion fund fill.

This is Jensen banking the boom **[I already called.](https://substack.com/redirect/eb842e4a-60e3-43fa-9895-acefb49f3975?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Nvidia prints while labs starve for iron. Now he seeds Brookfield so the fund can buy more of his iron. Circular. Profitable. Follow the $2 billion, not the safety panel.

I studied those pictures for a long while, and as a combat aviator, I am disgusted that the president thinks so little of our troops that he lies about this devastation.
Iranian strikes have damaged or destroyed hundreds of buildings across eight countries and close to 60 aircraft, including F-15s, an F-35, and as many as 30 Reaper drones.
Through June, 417 Americans were wounded and 18 dead, in a war Trump promised would wrap up in five weeks and is now grinding through month seven.
One deployed servicemember summed up the whole disgrace:
"We're not defending these bases. We're just watching them get destroyed."
He was answering Pete Hegseth, who once brushed off these attacks as a few "squirters" getting through.
Six American service members died in the strike he dismissed as nothing.

body:
Wake up. Equip. Mobilize.
| | | September 17, 2026 | [**Read Online**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/wvudg9wqo2ughkdqmnqt7hne9qkn3h8h2loxn/wnh2hghql9l3l6i7hx/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvcWR1OGg3aDQzZGV6ZHR6d25ubXc3dThudzJybjRmNGhrb3Z4OQ==) |
---

Friends,
To those of you who have already stepped forward and begun giving monthly: **thank you.**
We can’t say it enough.
Recurring supporters give [**Mobilize A Million**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/wvudg9wqo2ughkdqmnqt7hne9qkn3h8h2loxn/reh8hohmo9oeorf2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly9tb2JpbGl6ZWFtaWxsaW9uLm9yZy8=) something every movement needs: stability, momentum, and the ability to plan beyond the next week or the next appeal.
Month by month, your support helps sustain the tools, training, and infrastructure behind this work.
You are the muscle of [**Mobilize A Million**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/wvudg9wqo2ughkdqmnqt7hne9qkn3h8h2loxn/reh8hohmo9oeorf2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly9tb2JpbGl6ZWFtaWxsaW9uLm9yZy8=).
If you haven’t joined as a monthly supporter yet, that’s okay. I will carry you on this journey, showing you the heart of what we’re doing and what’s at stake. I’m confident that many more of you will make the pivotal decision to become a recurring supporter.
And to everyone who has already joined us: thank you for showing up early. Thank you for staying with us. Thank you for helping build what comes next.
**Wake up. Equip. Mobilize.**
For Freedom,
Sarah
| |
---
P.S. Happy Constitution Day.
On this day in 1787, a room full of ordinary men signed their names to an idea: that citizens could govern themselves, if they built the structure to make it possible — and then showed up to protect it.
That structure has held for over 200 years because generation after generation refused to let it become just words on paper.
That's what you're doing right now. Every monthly gift is a hand on the same work those delegates started — building the infrastructure that keeps self-government real.
They built the framework. We're the ones sworn to defend it. Wake up. Equip. Mobilize.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Peter, look
at this:

[ https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260917_2_gina.M30YD1&refcode=em20260917-4028&t=1001&akid=4028%2E587540%2EpzXr3W ][IMG]

In his four campaigns for governor, Greg Abbott has never once been shown
trailing in a statewide Texas poll. That changed today.

A brand-new poll just showed us ahead of Abbott by four points, while he's
asking Texans for a fourth term. Not within range. Not closing the gap.
Ahead. For the first time.

Here’s what’s happening: Texans are getting a clear look at what twelve
years of Greg Abbott has actually cost them. Rising grocery bills. Rising
property taxes. Data centers flooding the state while the people footing
the bill get nothing back. And when they look at me, they’re seeing
someone who’s spent her career fighting for Texas families — not just for
the people at the top.

None of this happens without you. We are competitive in this race because
of the 170,000 people who've chipped in to build this campaign. Our
people-powered movement is working. We are clearly breaking through.

But Abbott has a firehose of money aimed at us — $67 million in the bank,
and he's already outspent us 10-to-1. He's never had to run from behind
before. With this poll out there, he's going to open that firehose all the
way to drown out our campaign before Texans vote.

We can't match him dollar for dollar. But we can outnumber him — that's
how we got here. 170,000 donors have helped build this campaign into one

There's now a law in California with my name associated with it. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the **"Stop Nick Shirley Act"** means. On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law _actually_ does.

Here's what it really does, Friend: **it makes it harder for anyone -- me included -- to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent.** I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; _this is just the beginning._ Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. **The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General** -- the _one person_ in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it. That's not a coincidence, Friend.
